<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much will $46$ lollipops cost if they cost $\pounds 1.25$ each?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much will $46$ lollipops cost if they cost $\pounds 1.25$ each?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Price of 46 lollipops}    &= 46 \times \text{Price of 1 lollipop} \\\\
                                &= 46 \times 1.25 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 57.5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{lollipops}                            &:& \text{price} \\\\
= & 1                                           &:& \pounds 1.25 \\\\
= & 1 \times 46                                 &:& 1.25 \times 46 \\\\
= & 46                                          &:& \pounds 57.5
\end{array}
$

Price of $46$ lollipops $= \pounds 57.5$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 57.50$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jeff has $8$ pizzas to share between himself and his friends.

If each person is to get $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of a pizza how many friends can he feed?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jeff has $8$ pizzas to share between himself and his friends.
<emptyline>
If each person is to get $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of a pizza how many friends can he feed?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of persons}    &= \dfrac {\text{Total pizzas}} {\text{Pizza per person}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {8} { \dfrac {2} {3}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {8 \times 3} { 2} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {4 \times \cancel{2} \times 3} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
                            &= 4 \times 3 \\\\
                            &= 12 \\\\
\text{Number of friends}    &= 12 - 1 \\\\
                            &= 11
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{pizzas}                                                           &:& \text{persons} \\\\
= & \dfrac{2}{3}                                                            &:& 1 \\\\
= & \dfrac{2}{3} \times \dfrac{3}{2}                                        &:& 1 \times \dfrac{3}{2} \\\\
= & 1                                                                       &:& \dfrac{3}{2} \\\\
= & 1 \times 8                                                              &:& \dfrac{3 \times 8}{2} \\\\
= & 8                                                                       &:& \dfrac{3 \times 4 \times 2}{2} \\\\
= & 8                                                                       &:& \dfrac{3 \times 4 \times \cancel{2}}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
= & 8                                                                       &:& 12
\end{array}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of persons}    &= 12 \\\\
\text{Number of friends}    &= 12 - 1 \\\\
                            &= 11
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of persons $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{2}{3} \text{ pizzas} : 1 \text{ people}  &= 8 \text{ pizzas} : a \text{ persons} \\\\
\dfrac{2}{3 \times 1}                           &= \dfrac {8} {a} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {8 \times 3} { 2} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {4 \times \cancel{2} \times 3} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
a                                               &= 4 \times 3 \\\\
a                                               &= 12
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of persons}    &= 12 \\\\
\text{Number of friends}    &= 12 - 1 \\\\
                            &= 11
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11$

</div>
</div>

He needs to make $24$ toffee apples.

He uses the following recipe which makes $8$ toffee apples.

**Ingredients**

$400 \ \text{g}$ caster sugar

$1$ tsp lemon juice

$4$ tbsp golden syrup

red or black food colouring

</div>

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many tablespoons of golden syrup will he need?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many tablespoons of golden syrup will he need?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the count of tablespoons needed $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
8 \ \text{toffee apples} : 4 \ \text{tbsp}      &= 24 \ \text{toffee apples} : a \ \text{tbsp} \\\\
\dfrac{8} {4}                                   &= \dfrac {24} {a} \\\\
8 \times a                                      &= 24 \times 4 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {24 \times 4} {8} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 8 \times 4} {8} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {8} \times 4} {\cancel {8}} \\\\
a                                               &= 3 \times 4 \\\\
a                                               &= 12 \ \text{tbsp}
\end{aligned}
$

Golden syrup needed $= 12 \ \text{tbsp}$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratios, 

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{toffee apples}            &:&     \text{golden syrup} \\\\
= & 8                               &:&     4 \ \text{tbsp} \\\\
= & 8  \times 3                     &:&     4 \times 3 \\\\
= & 24                              &:&     12 \ \text{tbsp}                   
\end{array}
$

Golden syrup needed $= 12 \ \text{tbsp}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12 \ \text{tbsp}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

He already has $1 \ \text{kg}$ of caster sugar.
How many more grams will he need to buy?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of caster sugar needed $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
8 \ \text{toffee apples} : 400 \ \text{g}       &= 24 \ \text{toffee apples} : a \ \text{g} \\\\
\dfrac{8} {400}                                 &= \dfrac {24} {a} \\\\
8 \times a                                      &= 24 \times 400 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {24 \times 400} {8} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 8 \times 400} {8} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {8} \times 400} {\cancel {8}} \\\\
a                                               &= 3 \times 400 \\\\
a                                               &= 1200 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Extra caster sugar to buy}   &= 1200 - 400 \\\\
                                    &= 800 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

One quarter of the pupils in a class are girls. The rest are boys. What is the ratio of girls to boys?

-  $1:1$
-  $1:2$
-  $1:3$ 
-  $1:4$ 
-  $1:5$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>
-  $1:1$
-  $1:2$
-  $1:3$ 
-  $1:4$ 
-  $1:5$
</code></pre>
</div>

**Working**

If $\dfrac {1} {4}$ of the pupils are girls. Then $1 - \dfrac {1} {4} = \dfrac {3} {4}$ will be boys. Using that, we get

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{girls}                                &:& \text{boys} \\\\
= & \dfrac{1} {4}                               &:& \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
= & 1                                           &:& \dfrac {3 \times 4} {4} \\\\
= & 1                                           &:& \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
= & 1                                           &:& 3
\end{array}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On a train there are $140$ men and $200$ women. What is the ratio of men to women written in its simplest form?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On a train there are $140$ men and $200$ women. What is the ratio of men to women written in its simplest form?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Ratio}      &= \dfrac {\text{Number of men}} {\text{Number of women}} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {140} {200} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {20 \times 7} {20 \times 10} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {\cancel {20} \times 7} {\cancel {20} \times 10} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {7} {10} \\\\
                  &= 7 : 10
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

I am making a scale model of The Eye-Full Tower, which is $120 \ \text{m}$ tall. If the scale is $1:50$, how long will the model be (in cm)?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I am making a scale model of The Eye-Full Tower, which is $120 \ \text{m}$ tall. If the scale is $1:50$, how long will the model be (in cm)?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let length of the model $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
50 \ \text{m} : 1 \ \text{m}                    &= 120 \ \text{m} : a \ \text{m} \\\\
\dfrac {50} {1}                                 &= \dfrac {120} {a} \\\\
50 \times a                                     &= 120 \times 1 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {120} {50} \ \text{m} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {120 \times 100} {50} \ \text{cm} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {120 \times 50 \times 2} {50} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {120 \times \cancel {50} \times 2} {\cancel {50}} \\\\
a                                               &= 120 \times 2 \\\\
a                                               &= 240 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Length of the model $= 240 \ \text{cm}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{tower}                                &:& \text{model} \\\\
= & 50 \ \text{m}                               &:& 1 \ \text{m} \\\\
= & 50 \ \text{m}                               &:& 1 \times 100 \ \text{cm} \\\\
= & 50                                          &:& 100 \\\\
= & 1                                           &:& \dfrac {100} {50} \\\\
= & 1 \times 120                                &:& \dfrac {100 \times 120} {50} \\\\
= & 120                                         &:& \dfrac {50 \times 2 \times 120} {50} \\\\
= & 120                                         &:& \dfrac {\cancel {50} \times 2 \times 120} {\cancel {50}} \\\\
= & 120                                         &:& 2 \times 120 \\\\
= & 120 \ \text{m}                              &:& 240 \ \text{cm}
\end{array}
$

Length of the model $= 240 \ \text{cm}$
</div>
</div>

$240 \ \text{cm}$

</div>

My friend Sanjay is making a scale model of the London Ear (a famous landmark in London). 
The London Ear is $80 \ \text{m}$ tall and his model is $150 \ \text{cm}$ tall. What is the scale of the model, in its simplest form?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

The London Ear is $80 \ \text{m}$ tall and his model is $150 \ \text{cm}$ tall. What is the scale of the model, in its simplest form?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Scale}      &= \dfrac {\text{Length of the model}} {\text{Length of the tower}} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {150 \ \text{cm}} {80 \ \text{m}} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {150 \ \text{cm}} {80 \times 100 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {50 \times 3} {80 \times 50 \times 2} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {\cancel {50} \times 3} {80 \times \cancel {50} \times 2} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {3} {80 \times 2} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {3} {160} \\\\
                  &= 3 : 160
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

According to Nigella, when making a birthday cake, the perfect ratio of flour to sugar is $140:200$. What is this ratio in its simplest form?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">According to Nigella, when making a birthday cake, the perfect ratio of flour to sugar is $140:200$. What is this ratio in its simplest form?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Ratio}      &= \dfrac {140} {200} \\\\

                  &= \dfrac {7} {10} \\\\
                  &= 7 : 10
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

I am making a scale model of my yacht, which is $9 \ \text{m}$ long. If the scale is $1:30$, how long will the model yacht be (in cm)?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I am making a scale model of my yacht, which is $9 \ \text{m}$ long. If the scale is $1:30$, how long will the model yacht be (in cm)?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let length of the model yacht $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{m} : 30 \ \text{m}                    &= a \ \text{m} : 9 \ \text{m} \\\\
\dfrac{1} {30}                                  &= \dfrac {a} {9} \\\\
a \times 30                                     &= 9 \times 1 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {9} {30} \ \text{m} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 100} {30} \ \text{cm} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 3 \times 10 \times 10} {3 \times 10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 3 \times 10 \times \cancel {10}} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
a                                               &= 30 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Length of the model yacht $= 30 \ \text{cm}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

</div>
</div>

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{yacht}                  &:& \text{model} \\\\
= & 30 \ \text{m}                 &:& 1 \ \text{m} \\\\
= & 30 \ \text{m}                 &:& 1 \times 100 \ \text{cm} \\\\
= & 30 \ \text{m}                 &:& 100 \ \text{cm} \\\\
= & 1                             &:& \dfrac {100} {30} \\\\
= & 1 \times 9                    &:& \dfrac {100 \times 9} {30} \\\\
= & 9                             &:& \dfrac {100 \times 3 \times 3} {30} \\\\
= & 9                             &:& \dfrac {10 \cancel 0 \times 3 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3 \cancel 0} \\\\
= & 9                             &:& 10 \times 3 \\\\
= & 9 \ \text{m}                  &:& 30 \ \text{cm}
\end{array}
$

Length of the model yacht $= 30 \ \text{cm}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$30 \ \text{cm}$

</div>

**Question**

My friend Dave is making a scale model of Tower Bridge. Tower Bridge is $60 \ \text{m}$ tall and his model is $120 \ \text{cm}$ 
tall. What is the scale of the model, in its simplest form?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">My friend Dave is making a scale model of Tower Bridge. Tower Bridge is $60 \ \text{m}$ tall and his model is $120 \ \text{cm}$ 
tall. What is the scale of the model, in its simplest form?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Scale}      &= \dfrac {\text{Model}} {\text{Tower}} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {120 \ \text{cm}} {60 \ \text{m}} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {120 \ \text{cm}} {60 \times 100 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {2 \times 60} {60 \times 2 \times 50} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel {60}} {\cancel {60} \times \cancel 2 \times 50} \\\\
                  &= \dfrac {1} {50} \\\\
                  &= 1 : 50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$1 : 50$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Lollipops cost $12 \ \text{p}$ each, or a pack of $3$ costs $30 \ \text{p}$. 

I have $\pounds 2$ to spend. 

What is the maximum number of lollipops I can buy?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Lollipops cost $12 \ \text{p}$ each, or a pack of $3$ costs $30 \ \text{p}$. 
<emptyline>
I have $\pounds 2$ to spend. 
<emptyline>
What is the maximum number of lollipops I can buy?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Lets find out how many packs of $3$ lollipops can be bought, then we find how many individual lollipops can be bought with the remaining money. 

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of packs}             &= \dfrac {\pounds 2} {30 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {200 \ \text{p}} {30 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                    &= 6 \ \text {remainder } 20 \\\\
                                    &\approx 6 \\\\
\text {Money left}                  &= 200 - 6 \times 30 \\\\
                                    &= 200 - 180 \\\\
                                    &= 20 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text {Extra lollipops we can buy}  &= \dfrac {20} {12} \\\\
                                    &= 1 \ \text {remainder} \ 8 \\\\
                                    &\approx 1 \\\\
\text {Total lollipops}             &= 6 \times 3 + 1 \\\\
                                    &= 18 + 1 \\\\
                                    &= 19
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$19$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Every $100 \ \text{g}$ of brown bread contains $6 \ \text{g}$ of fibre. 

A small loaf weighs $400 \ \text{g}$ and has $10$ equal slices. 

How much fibre is there in one slice?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Every $100 \ \text{g}$ of brown bread contains $6 \ \text{g}$ of fibre. 
<emptyline>
A small loaf weighs $400 \ \text{g}$ and has $10$ equal slices. 
<emptyline>
How much fibre is there in one slice?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{bread}                  &:& \text{fibre} \\\\
= & 100 \ \text{g}                &:& 6 \ \text{g} \\\\
= & 100 \times 4 \ \text{g}       &:& 6 \times 4 \ \text{g} \\\\
= & 400 \ \text{g}                &:& 24 \ \text{g} \\\\
= & 10 \ \text{slice}             &:& 24 \ \text{g} \\\\
= & 1 \ \text{slice}              &:& \dfrac {24} {10} \ \text{g} \\\\
= & 1 \ \text{slice}              &:& 2.4 \ \text{g}
\end{array}
$

Fibre in one slice $= 2.4 \ \text{g}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2.4 \ \text {g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A litre of water wieghs $1 \ \text{kg}$ and a litre of ice weighs $900 \ \text{g}$.

How many more grams will $6 \ \text{litres}$ of water weigh compared to $5 \ \text{litres}$ of ice?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A litre of water wieghs $1 \ \text{kg}$ and a litre of ice weighs $900 \ \text{g}$.
<emptyline>
How many more grams will $6 \ \text{litres}$ of water weigh compared to $5 \ \text{litres}$ of ice?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Weight of 6 litres of water}    &= 6 \times 1 \\\\
                                      &= 6 \ \text{kg} \\\\
                                      &= 6 \times 1000 \ \text{g} \\\\
                                      &= 6000 \ \text{g} \\\\
\text{Weight of 5 litres of ice}      &= 5 \times 900 \\\\
                                      &= 4500 \ \text{g} \\\\
\text{Difference}                     &= 6000 - 4500 \\\\
                                      &= 1500 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1500 \ \text{g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$5$ toffees weigh the same as $6$ maltesers and $3$ toffees.

How many maltesers would weigh the same as $9$ toffees?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$5$ toffees weigh the same as $6$ maltesers and $3$ toffees.
<emptyline>
How many maltesers would weigh the same as $9$ toffees?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let number of maltesers $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
(5 - 3) \ \text{toffees} : 6 \ \text{maltesers} &= 9 \ \text{toffees} : a \ \text{maltesers} \\\\
\dfrac{2} {6}                                   &= \dfrac {9} {a} \\\\
2 \times a                                      &= 9 \times 6 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 6} {2} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel 2 \times 3} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a                                               &= 9 \times 3 \\\\
a                                               &= 27
\end{aligned}
$

Number of maltesers $= 27$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{toffees}                    &:& \text{maltesers} \\\\
= & (5 - 3)                           &:& 6 \\\\
= & 2                                 &:& 6 \\\\
= & 1                                 &:& \dfrac {6} {2} \\\\
= & 1 \times 9                        &:& \dfrac {6 \times 9} {2} \\\\
= & 9                                 &:& \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 9} {2} \\\\
= & 9                                 &:& \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 3 \times 9} {\cancel 2} \\\\
= & 9                                 &:& 3 \times 9 \\\\
= & 9                                 &:& 27
\end{array}
$

Number of maltesers $= 27$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much **cordial** does she need to make **three** glasses of squash?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much **cordial** does she need to make **three** glasses of squash?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the quantity of cordial needed $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
320 \ \text{ml} : 8 \ \text{glasses}            &= a \ \text{ml} : 3 \ \text{glasses} \\\\
\dfrac{320} {8}                                 &= \dfrac {a} {3} \\\\
8 \times a                                      &= 320 \times 3 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {320 \times 3} {8} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {8 \times 40 \times 3} {8} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 8 \times 40 \times 3} {\cancel 8} \\\\
a                                               &= 40 \times 3 \\\\
a                                               &= 120 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

Cordial needed $= 120 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{glasses}                          &:& \text{cordial} \\\\
= & 8                                       &:& 320 \ \text{ml} \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& \dfrac {320} {8} \\\\
= & 1 \times 3                              &:& \dfrac {320 \times 3} {8} \\\\
= & 3                                       &:& \dfrac {8 \times 40 \times 3} {8} \\\\
= & 3                                       &:& \dfrac {\cancel 8 \times 40 \times 3} {\cancel 8} \\\\
= & 3                                       &:& 40 \times 3 \\\\
= & 3                                       &:& 120 \ \text{ml}
\end{array}
$

Cordial needed $= 120 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

How many euros would be worth the same as $\pounds 500$ (pounds)?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many euros would be worth the same as $\pounds 500$ (pounds)?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the euros $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 100 : \text{€} 120                   &= \pounds 500 : \text{€} a  \\\\
\dfrac{100}{120}                      &= \dfrac{500}{a} \\\\
100 \times a                          &= 500 \times 120 \\\\
a                                     &= \dfrac{500 \times 120}{100} \\\\
a                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 100 \times 120}{100} \\\\
a                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times \cancel{100} \times 120}{\cancel{100}} \\\\
a                                     &= 5 \times 120 \\\\
a                                     &= \text{€} 600 
\end{aligned}
$

Amount $= \text{€} 600$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

  & \pounds &:& \text{€} \\\\
= & 100     &:& 120 \\\\
= & 100 \times 5 &:& 120 \times 5 \\\\
= & \pounds 500 &:& \text{€} 600 
\end{array}
$

Amount $= \text{€} 600$
</div>
</div>

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 100 : \text{€} 120  &= \pounds a : \text{€} 300  \\\\

a                         &= 25 \times 10 \\\\
a                         &= \pounds 250
\end{aligned}
$

Amount $= \pounds 250$

**Question**

Bruno has $\pounds 600$ (pounds). Marie has $\text{€}700$ (euros). Decide who has the most money. Explain how you decided.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bruno has $\pounds 600$ (pounds). Marie has $\euro700$ (euros). Decide who has the most money. Explain how you decided.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's convert pounds into euros to compare them.

Let the euros Bruno has $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 100 : \text{€} 120  &= \pounds 600 : a  \\\\
\dfrac{100}{120} &= \dfrac{600}{a} \\\\
100a &= 600 \times 120 \\\\
a                     &= \dfrac{600 \times 120}{100} \\\\
a                     &= \dfrac{6 \times 100 \times 120}{100} \\\\
a                     &= \dfrac{6 \times \cancel{100} \times 120}{\cancel{100}} \\\\
a                     &= 6 \times 120 \\\\
a                     &= \text{€} 720 
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Difference}  &= \text {Bruno} - \text {Marie} \\\\
                    &= 720 - 700 \\\\
                    &= \text{€} 20
\end{aligned}
$

Bruno has $\text{€} 20$ more than Marie.
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

**Boys and girls**

At Casterbridge Academy the ratio of boys to girls is exactly $5{:}6$.

There are $200$ **boys** at Casterbridge Academy.

Work out the number of **girls** at Casterbridge Academy.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">**Boys and girls**
<emptyline>
At Casterbridge Academy the ratio of boys to girls is exactly $5{:}6$.
<emptyline>
There are $200$ **boys** at Casterbridge Academy.
<emptyline>
Work out the number of **girls** at Casterbridge Academy.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let number of girls $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{boys} : 6 \ \text{girls}              &= 200 \ \text{boys} : a \ \text{girls} \\\\
\dfrac{5} {6}                                   &= \dfrac {200} {a} \\\\
5 \times a                                      &= 200 \times 6 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {200 \times 6} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times 40 \times 6} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 40 \times 6} {\cancel 5} \\\\
a                                               &= 40 \times 6 \\\\
a                                               &= 240
\end{aligned}
$

Number of girls $= 240$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{boys}                   &:& \text{girls} \\\\
= & 5                             &:& 6 \\\\
= & 1                             &:& \dfrac{6} {5} \\\\
= & 1 \times 200                  &:& \dfrac{6 \times 200} {5} \\\\
= & 200                           &:& \dfrac{6 \times 5 \times 40} {5} \\\\
= & 200                           &:& \dfrac{6 \times \cancel 5 \times 40} {\cancel 5} \\\\
= & 200                           &:& 6 \times 40 \\\\
= & 200                           &:& 240
\end{array}
$

Number of girls $= 240$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$240$

</div>
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of inches $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{inch} : 2.5 \ \text{cm}           &= a \ \text{inch} : 100 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\dfrac{1} {2.5}                             &= \dfrac{a} {100} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac{100} {2.5} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac{100 \times 10} {2.5 \times 10} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac{1000} {25} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac{25 \times 40} {25} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac{\cancel{25} \times 40} {\cancel{25}} \\\\
a                                           &= 40 \ \text{inches}
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= 40 \ \text{inches}$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

= & 2.5 \ \text{cm}               &:& 1 \ \text{inch} \\\\
= & 2.5 \times 40 \ \text{cm}     &:& 1 \times 40 \ \text{inch} \\\\
= & 100 \ \text{cm}               &:& 40 \ \text{inch} \\\\
= & 1 \ \text{m}                  &:& 40 \ \text{inch}
\end{array}
$

Answer $= 40 \ \text{inches}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$5 \ \text{gallons} = 22.82 \ \text{litres}$

Which is nearest to $1 \ \text{gallon}$?

- $4.528$
- $4.448$
- $4.645$
- $4.565$
- $4.504$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$5 \ \text{gallons} = 22.82 \ \text{litres}$
<emptyline>

<emptyline>
- $4.528$
- $4.448$
- $4.645$
- $4.565$
- $4.504$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{1 gallon}       &= \dfrac {22.82} {5} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {22.82 \times 2} {5 \times 2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {45.64} {10} \\\\
                      &= 4.564 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$

Nearest value $= 4.565 \ \text{litres}$
</div>

\end{array}
$

Nearest value $= 4.565 \ \text{litres}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$48$ pencils cost $\pounds 11.04$.  What is the cost of each pencil?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$48$ pencils cost $\pounds 11.04$.  What is the cost of each pencil?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 pencil}       &= \dfrac {\pounds  11.04} {48} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {1104 \ \text{p}} {48}  \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {23 \times 48} {48} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {23 \times \cancel {48}} {\cancel {48}} \\\\
                              &= 23 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{pencils}                &:& \text{cost} \\\\
= & 48                            &:& \pounds 11.04 \\\\
= & 1                             &:& \dfrac {\pounds 11.04} {48} \\\\
= & 1                             &:& \dfrac {1104 \ \text{p}} {48}  \\\\
= & 1                             &:& \dfrac {48 \times 23} {48} \\\\
= & 1                             &:& \dfrac {\cancel {48} \times 23} {\cancel {48}} \\\\
= & 1                             &:& 23 \ \text{p}
\end{array}
$

Cost of each pencil $= 23 \ \text{p}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$23 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Chocolate bars are packed in boxes of $24$. A shop buys $16$ boxes.

How many chocolate bars are in $16$ boxes?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                            &= 384
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$36$ pencils cost $\pounds 7.92$.  What is the cost of each pencil?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$36$ pencils cost $\pounds 7.92$.  What is the cost of each pencil?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 pencil}       &= \dfrac {\pounds 7.92} {36} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {792 \ \text{p}} {36}  \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {36 \times 22} {36} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {\cancel {36} \times 22} {\cancel {36}} \\\\
                              &= 22 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

= & 1                             &:& \dfrac{\cancel {36} \times 22} {\cancel {36}} \\\\
= & 1                             &:& 22 \ \text{p}
\end{array}
$

Cost of pencil $= 22 \ \text{p}$
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There is $5.5 \ \text{g}$ of sugar in every $10 \ \text{g}$ of jam. How much sugar is in $600 \ \text{g}$ of jam?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of sugar $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
5.5 \ \text{g} : 10 \ \text{g}                  &= a \ \text{g} : 600 \ \text{g} \\\\
\dfrac{5.5} {10}                                &= \dfrac {a} {600} \\\\
a \times 10                                     &=  5.5 \times 600 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5.5 \times 600} {10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5.5 \times 10 \times 60} {10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5.5 \times 1 \cancel {0} \times 60} {1 \cancel {0}} \\\\
a                                               &= 5.5 \times 60 \\\\
a                                               &= 330 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$

Amount of sugar $= 330 \ \text{g}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{jam}                    &:& \text{sugar} \\\\
= & 10 \ \text{g}                 &:& 5.5 \ \text{g} \\\\
= & 10 \times 60                  &:& 5.5 \times 60 \\\\
= & 600 \ \text{g}                &:& 330 \ \text{g}
\end{array}
$

Amount of sugar $= 330 \ \text{g}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$5 \ \text{gallons} = 22.82 \ \text{litres}$

Which is nearest to $1 \ \text{gallon}$?

- $4.528$
- $4.448$
- $4.645$
- $4.565$
- $4.504$


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<emptyline>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{1 gallon}       &= \dfrac {22.82} {5} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {22.82 \times 2} {5 \times 2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {45.64} {10} \\\\
                      &= 4.564 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$

Nearest value $= 4.565 \ \text{litres}$.

= & 1 \ \text{gallon}   &:& 4.564 \ \text{litres}
\end{array}
$

Nearest value $= 4.565 \ \text{litres}$.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$36$ pencils cost $\pounds 7.92$. What is the cost of each pencil?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$36$ pencils cost $\pounds 7.92$. What is the cost of each pencil?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 pencil}       &= \dfrac{\pounds  7.92} {36} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {792 \ \text{p}} {36}  \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {36 \times 22} {36} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {\cancel {36} \times 22} {\cancel {36}} \\\\
                              &= 22 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

\end{array}

Cost of each pencil $= 22 \ \text{p}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

One pint is $568\ \text{ml}$. How many ml is half a pint?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">One pint is $568\ \text{ml}$. How many ml is half a pint?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Half pint}            &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 568 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {568} {2}  \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {2 \times 284} {2}  \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 284} {\cancel 2}  \\\\
                            &= 284 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{pint}                     &:& \text{ml} \\\\
= & 1                               &:& 568 \\\\
= & \dfrac {1} {2}                  &:& \dfrac {568} {2} \\\\
= & \dfrac {1} {2}                  &:& \dfrac {2 \times 284} {2} \\\\
= & \dfrac {1} {2}                  &:& \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 284} {\cancel 2} \\\\
= & \dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{pint}    &:& 284 \ \text{ml}
\end{array}
$

Half pint $= 284 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out how long it would take for $2$ chimps to eat $6$ bananas.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out how long it would take for $2$ chimps to eat $6$ bananas.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the time it takes $= t$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \ \text{bananas} : 4 \ \text{minutes}         &= 6 \ \text{bananas} : t \ \text{minutes} \\\\
\dfrac{3} {4}                                   &= \dfrac {6} {t} \\\\
3 \times t                                      &= 6 \times 4 \\\\
t                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 4} {3} \\\\
t                                               &= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 4} {3} \\\\
t                                               &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 3 \times 4} {\cancel 3} \\\\
t                                               &= 8 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

Time taken $= 8 \ \text{minutes}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{bananas}                    &:& \text{time} \\\\
= & 3                                           &:& 4 \ \text{min} \\\\
= & 1                                           &:& \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
= & 6                                           &:& \dfrac {4 \times 6} {3} \\\\
= & 6                                           &:& \dfrac {4 \times 3 \times 2} {3} \\\\
= & 6                                           &:& \dfrac {4 \times \cancel 3 \times 2} {\cancel 3} \\\\
= & 6                                           &:& 8 \ \text{min} \\\\
\end{array}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$8 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out how many chimps would be required to eat $21$ bananas in $8 \ \text{minutes}$. 
(You can assume that the tree has a large number of bananas available and that the chimps all have big appetites!)
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If there are **more** chimps, they can eat **more** bananas in the same time. So numbers of chimps is **directly** proportional to bananas.

If there are **more** chimps, it will take **less** time to eat the same number of bananas. So numbers of chimps is **inversely** proportional to time.

Using that,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{chimps} &\propto \text{bananas} \\\\
\text{chimps} & \propto \dfrac {1} {\text{time}} \\\\
\text{chimps} & \propto \dfrac {\text{bananas}} {\text{time}} 
\end{aligned}
$

Let the number of chimps $= c$

Using compound ratio (direct proportion with bananas and inverse proportion with time),

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \ \text{chimps} : 3 \ \text{bananas} : 4 \ \text{minutes}   &= c \ \text{chimps} : 21 \ \text{bananas} : 8 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
\dfrac {c} {2}                                                &= \dfrac {21} {3} \times \dfrac {4} {8} \\\\
c                                                             &= \dfrac {2 \times 21 \times 4} {3 \times 8} \\\\
c                                                             &= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 7 \times 4} {3 \times 2 \times 4} \\\\
c                                                             &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times 7 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
c                                                             &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

Number of chimps $= 7$
</div>

\end{aligned}
$

Using compound ratio (direct proportion with bananas and time constant),

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The distance from Calais to Paris is $320 \ \text{km}$.

$5 \ \text{miles}$ is approximately $8 \ \text{kilometres}$.
 
Calculate the approximate distance in miles from Calais to Paris.  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The distance from Calais to Paris is $320 \ \text{km}$.
<emptyline>
$5 \ \text{miles}$ is approximately $8 \ \text{kilometres}$.
<emptyline>
Calculate the approximate distance in miles from Calais to Paris.  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let number of miles $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{miles} : 8 \ \text{km}           &= a \ \text{miles} : 320 \ \text{km}  \\\\
\dfrac{5}{8}                               &= \dfrac{a}{320} \\\\
8 \times a                                 &= 320 \times 5 \\\\
a                                          &= \dfrac{320 \times 5}{8} \\\\
a                                          &= \dfrac{40 \times 8 \times 5}{8} \\\\
a                                          &= \dfrac{\cancel 8 \times 40 \times 5}{\cancel 8} \\\\
a                                          &= 40 \times 5 \\\\
a                                          &= 200
\end{aligned}
$

Distance in miles $= 200 \ \text{miles}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{km}                     &:& \text{miles} \\\\
= & 8                             &:& 5  \\\\
= & 1                             &:& \dfrac{5}{8}  \\\\
= & 320                           &:& \dfrac{320 \times 5}{8}  \\\\
= & 320                           &:& \dfrac{8 \times 40 \times 5}{8} \\\\
= & 320                           &:& \dfrac{\cancel 8 \times 40 \times 5}{\cancel 8} \\\\
= & 320                           &:& 5 \times 40 \\\\
= & 320 \ \text{km}               &:& 200 \ \text{miles}
\end{array}
$

Distance in miles $= 200 \ \text{miles}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$200 \ \text {miles}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On a bus, the ratio of men and women is $5:4$. If there are $12$ women on the bus, how many men are on the bus?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On a bus, the ratio of men and women is $5:4$. If there are $12$ women on the bus, how many men are on the bus?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of men $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{men} : 4 \ \text{women}              &= a \ \text{men} : 12 \ \text{women} \\\\
\dfrac{5} {4}                                  &= \dfrac{a} {12} \\\\
4 \times a                                     &= 5 \times 12 \\\\
a                                              &= \dfrac{5 \times 12} {4} \\\\
a                                              &= \dfrac{5 \times 3 \times 4} {4} \\\\
a                                              &= \dfrac{5 \times 3 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                              &= 5 \times 3 \\\\
a                                              &= 15
\end{aligned}
$

Number of men $= 15$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{men}                   &:& \text{women} \\\\
= & 5                            &:& 4 \\\\
= & 5 \times 3                   &:& 4 \times 3 \\\\
= & 15                           &:& 12
\end{array}
$

Number of men $= 15$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15$


</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a group of $48$ children, the ratio of boys to girls is $3:5.$ How many boys must join the group to make the ratio of boys to girls $5:3?$

- $40$ 
- $32$ 
- $24$ 
- $8$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a group of $48$ children, the ratio of boys to girls is $3:5.$ How many boys must join the group to make the ratio of boys to girls $5:3?$
<emptyline>
- $40$ 
- $32$ 
- $24$ 
- $8$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Original number of boys} &= 48 \times \dfrac {3} {3 + 5} \\\\
                              &= 48 \times \dfrac {3} {8} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac{48 \times 3} {8} \\\\
                              &= 6 \times 3 \\\\
                              &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

Let the number of boys that join the group $= a$

Using equivalent ratio for the new group,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{boys} : 3 \ \text{girls}            &= (18 + a) \ \text{boys} : 30 \ \text{girls} \\\\
\dfrac{5} {3}                              &= \dfrac{18 + a} {30} \\\\
3 \times (18 + a)                             &= 5 \times 30 \\\\
a + 18                                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 30} {3} \\\\
a + 18                                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 10 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a + 18                                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 10 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a + 18                                        &= 5 \times 10 \\\\
a + 18                                        &= 50 \\\\
a                                             &= 50 - 18 \\\\
a                                             &= 32
\end{aligned}
$

Number of boys that must join $= 32$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$32$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In $1970$, $\pounds 1$ was worth the same as $\text{\textdollar} 2.50$.
How many pounds was $\text{\textdollar} 1000$ worth? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In $1970$, $\pounds 1$ was worth the same as $\text{\textdollar} 2.50$.
How many pounds was $\text{\textdollar} 1000$ worth? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the value (in $\pounds$) $= p$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 : 2.50                &= p : 1000 \\\\
\dfrac{1}{2.5}          &= \dfrac {p} {1000} \\\\
p                       &= \dfrac {1000 \times 1} {2.5} \\\\
p                       &= \dfrac {25 \times 400 \times 10} {25} \\\\
p                       &= \dfrac {\cancel{25} \times 40 \times 10} {\cancel{25}} \\\\
p                       &= \pounds 400
\end{aligned}
$

Value $= \pounds 400$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \pounds                 &:& \text{\textdollar} \\\\
= & 1                       &:& 2.50 \\\\
= & 1 \times 400            &:& 2.50 \times 400 \\\\
= & \pounds 400             &:& \text{\textdollar} 1000
\end{array}
$

Value $= \pounds 400$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 400$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On one day in $2008$, $\pounds 1$ was worth $\text{\textdollar} 1.25$. What was $\text{\textdollar} 1$ worth in pence on that day?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On one day in $2008$, $\pounds 1$ was worth $\text{\textdollar} 1.25$. What was $\text{\textdollar} 1$ worth in pence on that day?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the value of $\text{\textdollar} 1$ in pounds $= p$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 1 : \text{\textdollar} 1.25    &= \pounds p : \text{\textdollar} 1 \\\\
\dfrac{1} {1.25}                       &= \dfrac{p} {1} \\\\
p                                      &= \dfrac{1} {1.25} \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac{100} {125} \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac{100 \times 100 \ \text{p}} {125} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac{5 \times 20 \times 4 \times 25} {5 \times 25} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 20 \times 4 \times \cancel{25}} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel{25}} \\\\
                                      &= 20 \times 4  \\\\
                                      &= 80 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

= & 1                         &:& \dfrac{5 \times 20 \times 4 \times 25} {5 \times 25} \\\\
= & 1                         &:& \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 20 \times 4 \times \cancel{25}} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel{25}} \\\\
= & 1                         &:& 20 \times 4  \\\\
= & 1                         &:& 80 \ \text{p}
\end{array}
$

Answer $= 80 \ \text{p}$
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Look at this information about recycling:

25 large plastic bottles can be recycled to make 1 fleece jacket.

Write the missing number in this sentence.

200 large plastic bottles can be recycled to make 
$\text{\textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore}$ fleece jackets.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Look at this information about recycling:
<emptyline>
25 large plastic bottles can be recycled to make 1 fleece jacket.
<emptyline>
Write the missing number in this sentence.
<emptyline>
200 large plastic bottles can be recycled to make 
$\text{\textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore}$ fleece jackets.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of fleece jackets made $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
25 \ \text{bottles} : 1 \ \text{jacket}         &= 200 \ \text{bottles} : a \ \text{jackets} \\\\
\dfrac {25} {1}                                 &= \dfrac {200} {a} \\\\
25 \times a                                     &= 200 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {200} {25} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {25 \times 8} {25} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel {25} \times 8} {\cancel {25}} \\\\
a                                               &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

Number of fleece jackets $= 8$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**
