$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{bottles}                              &:& \text{jackets} \\\\
= & 25                                          &:& 1 \\\\
= & 1                                           &:& \dfrac {1} {25} \\\\
= & 1 \times 200                                &:& \dfrac {200} {25} \\\\
= & 200                                         &:& \dfrac {25 \times 8} {25} \\\\
= & 200                                         &:& \dfrac {\cancel {25} \times 8} {\cancel {25}} \\\\
= & 200                                         &:& 8
\end{array}
$

Number of fleece jackets $= 8$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

In a survey, $9$ **out of** $10$ people said they would like to recycle more.

What percentage of people said they would like to recycle more?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a survey, $9$ **out of** $10$ people said they would like to recycle more.
<emptyline>
What percentage of people said they would like to recycle more?
</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage}   &= \dfrac {9} {10} \times 100 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {9 \times 100} {10} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {9 \times 10 \cancel {0}} {1\cancel {0}} \\\\
                    &= 90 \ \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Dave and Eddie are cycling around a track. Dave completes a lap every $30\ \text{seconds}$, and Eddie completes a lap every $25\ \text{seconds}$. How many laps will Eddie complete in the time it takes Dave to complete $15$ laps?

- $15$ 
- $16$ 
- $18$ 
- $20$ 
- $25$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Dave and Eddie are cycling around a track. Dave completes a lap every $30\ \text{seconds}$, and Eddie completes a lap every $25\ \text{seconds}$. How many laps will Eddie complete in the time it takes Dave to complete $15$ laps?
<emptyline>
- $15$ 
- $16$ 
- $18$ 
- $20$ 
- $25$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ann and Ben share $28$ sweets in the ratio $4 : 3$

(Ann has $4$ sweets for every $3$ sweets that Ben has). 

How many sweets do they each receive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ann and Ben share $28$ sweets in the ratio $4 : 3$
<emptyline>
(Ann has $4$ sweets for every $3$ sweets that Ben has). 
<emptyline>
How many sweets do they each receive?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sweets received by Ann}                   &= \dfrac {4} {4 + 3} \times 28 \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {4} {7} \times 28 \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {4 \times 28} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {4 \times 7 \times 4} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {4 \times \cancel 7 \times 4} {\cancel 7} \\\\
                                                &= 4 \times 4 \\\\
                                                &= 16 \\\\
\text{Sweets received by Ben}                   &= 28 - 16 \\\\
                                                &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the sweets received by Ann $= a$

Sweets received by Ben $= 28 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 : 3                                           &= a : (28 - a) \\\\
\dfrac{4} {3}                                   &= \dfrac {a} {28 - a} \\\\
4 \times (28 - a)                               &= a \times 3 \\\\
112 - 4a                                        &= 3a \\\\
112                                             &= 3a + 4a \\\\
3a + 4a                                         &= 112 \\\\
7a                                              &= 112 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {112} {7} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 16} {7} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 7 \times 16} {\cancel 7} \\\\
a                                               &= 16 \\\\
\text{Sweets received by Ann}                   &= 16 \\\\
\text{Sweets received by Ben}                   &= 28 - 16 \\\\
                                                &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{total}            &:& \text{Ann}                  &:& \text{Ben} \\\\
= & 4 + 3                   &:& 4                           &:& 3 \\\\
= & 7                       &:& 4                           &:& 3 \\\\
= & 7 \times 4              &:& 4 \times 4                  &:& 3 \times 4 \\\\
= & 28                      &:& 16                          &:& 12
\end{array}
$

Sweets received by Ann $= 16$

Sweets received by Ben $= 12$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$16, 12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A necklace is made from black and white beads in a ratio of $3 : 2$, in other words for every $3$ black beads there were $2$ white beads.

$\spadesuit \quad \spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit$

If there are $80$ beads altogether, how many beads are black?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A necklace is made from black and white beads in a ratio of $3 : 2$, in other words for every $3$ black beads there were $2$ white beads.
<emptyline>
$\spadesuit \quad \spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit \quad\spadesuit$
<emptyline>
If there are $80$ beads altogether, how many beads are black?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of black beads $= 3a$

Let the number of white beads $= 2a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3a + 2a               &= 80 \\\\
5a                    &= 80 \\\\
a                     &= \dfrac{80}{5} \\\\
a                     &= 16 \\\\
\text{Black beads}    &= 3a \\\\
&=                    3 \times 16 \\\\
&=                    48
\end{aligned}
$

Number of black beads $= 48$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let number of black beads $= a$

Number of white beads $= 80 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \ \text{black} : 2 \ \text{white}   &= a \ \text{black} : (80 - a) \ \text{white} \\\\
\dfrac{3} {2}                         &= \dfrac {a} {80 - a} \\\\
3 \times (80 - a)                     &= a \times 2 \\\\
240 - 3a                              &= 2a \\\\
240                                   &= 2a + 3a \\\\
2a + 3a                               &= 240 \\\\
5a                                    &= 240 \\\\
a                                     &= \dfrac {240} {5} \\\\
a                                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 48} {5} \\\\
a                                     &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 48} {\cancel 5} \\\\
a                                     &= 48
\end{aligned}
$

Number of black beads $= 48$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{necklace}                             &:& \text{black beads} \\\\
= & 2 + 3                                       &:& 3 \\\\
= & 5                                           &:& 3 \\\\
= & 5 \times 16                                 &:& 3 \times 16 \\\\
= & 80                                          &:& 48
\end{array}
$

Number of black beads $= 48$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$48$

</div>
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of screenwash mixed $= c$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{ml} : 9 \ \text{ml}                   &= c \ \text{ml} : 450 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\dfrac {1} {9}                                   &= \dfrac {c} {450} \\\\
c                                               &= \dfrac {450} {9} \\\\
c                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 50} {9} \\\\
c                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 9 \times 50} {\cancel 9} \\\\
c                                               &= 50 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

Screenwash mixed $= 50 \ \text{ml}$

**Question**

How many boy scouts will eat $60$ loaves in $4 \ \text{days}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let number of boy scouts $= b$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
30 \ \text{loaves} : 12 \ \text{scouts} &= 60 \ \text{loaves} : b \ \text{scouts} \\\\
\dfrac{30}{12} &= \dfrac{60}{b} \\\\
30 \times b &= 60 \times 12 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{60 \times 12}{30} \\\\
b &= \dfrac{2 \times 30 \times 12}{30} \\\\
b &= \dfrac{2 \times \cancel{30} \times 12}{\cancel{30}} \\\\
b &= 2 \times 12 \\\\
b &= 24
\end{aligned}
$

Number of boy scouts $= 24$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many days will it take $6$ boy scouts to eat $30$ loaves?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many days will it take $6$ boy scouts to eat $30$ loaves?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If there are **fewer** scouts, it will take **more** days to finish loaves. So days is **inversely** proportional to scouts.

$\text{days} \propto \dfrac{1}{\text{scouts}}$

Let days $= d$

Using equivalent ratio (inverse proportion with scouts),

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \ \text{days} : 12 \ \text{scouts}  &= d \ \text{days} : 6 \ \text{scouts} \\\\
\dfrac{4}{d}                          &= \dfrac{6}{12} \\\\
d                                     &= \dfrac{12 \times 4}{6} \\\\
d                                     &= \dfrac{6 \times 2 \times 4}{6} \\\\
d                                     &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 2 \times 4} {\cancel 6} \\\\
d                                     &= 2 \times 4 \\\\
d                                     &= 8 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Time taken $= 8 \ \text{days}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If there are **fewer** scouts, it will take **more** days to finish loaves. So days is **inversely** proportional to scouts.

$\text{days} \propto \dfrac{1}{\text{scouts}}$

Using ratio (inverse proportion with scouts),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccc}
  & \text{scouts}        &:& \text{days} \\\\
= & 12                   &:& 4 \\\\
= & 1                    &:& 4 \times 12 \\\\
= & 1 \times 6           &:& \dfrac{4 \times 12}{6} \\\\
= & 6                    &:& \dfrac{4 \times 2 \times 6}{6} \\\\
= & 6                    &:& \dfrac{4 \times 2 \times \cancel 6}{\cancel 6} \\\\
= & 6                    &:& 4 \times 2 \\\\
= & 6                    &:& 8 \ \text{days}
\end{array}
$

Time taken $= 8 \ \text{days}$
</div>
</div>

$8 \ \text{days}$

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many loaves will $3$ boy scouts eat in $8 \ \text{days}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many loaves will $3$ boy scouts eat in $8 \ \text{days}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If there are **more** loaves, it will take **more** days to eat them. So loaves are directly proportional to days.

If there are **more** loaves, it will take **more** scouts to eat them. So loaves are directly proportional to scouts.

Using that,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{loaves} &\propto \text{scouts} \\\\
\text{loaves} & \propto \text{days} \\\\
\text{loaves} & \propto \text{scouts} \times \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Let number of loaves $= l$

Using compound ratio (direct proportion with scouts and days):

$
\begin{aligned}
30 \ \text{loaves} : 12 \ \text{scouts} : 4 \ \text{days} &= l \ \text{loaves} : 3 \ \text{scouts} : 8 \ \text{days} \\\\
\dfrac{l}{30}                                             &= \dfrac{3}{12} \times \dfrac{8}{4} \\\\
l                                                         &= \dfrac{30 \times 3 \times 8}{12 \times 4} \\\\
l                                                         &= \dfrac{5 \times 6 \times 3 \times 4 \times 2}{6 \times 2 \times 4} \\\\
l                                                         &= \dfrac{5 \times \cancel 6 \times 3 \times \cancel 4 \times \cancel 2}{\cancel 6 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
l                                                         &= 5 \times 3 \\\\
l                                                         &= 15
\end{aligned}
$

Number of loaves $= 15$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If there are **more** loaves, it will take **more** days to eat them. So loaves are directly proportional to days.

If there are **more** loaves, it will take **more** scouts to eat them. So loaves are directly proportional to scouts.

Using that,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{loaves} &\propto \text{scouts} \\\\
\text{loaves} & \propto \text{days} \\\\
\text{loaves} & \propto \text{scouts} \times \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Using compound ratio (direct proportion with scouts and days constant),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{scouts}                &:& \text{days}                   &:& \text{loaves} \\\\
= & 12                            &:& 4                             &:& 30  \\\\
= & 1                             &:& 4                             &:& \dfrac {30} {12}  \\\\
= & 3 \times 1                 &:& 4                                &:& 3 \times \dfrac {30} {12} \\\\
= & 3                            &:& 4                             &:& \dfrac {3 \times 30} {12} \\\\
\end{array}
$

Using compound ratio (direct proportion with days and scouts constant),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{scouts}                &:& \text{days}                   &:& \text{loaves} \\\\
= & 3                            &:& 4                             &:& \dfrac {3 \times 30} {12} \\\\
= & 3                            &:& 1                             &:& \dfrac {3 \times 30} {12 \times 4} \\\\
= & 3                            &:& 1 \times 8                     &:& \dfrac {3 \times 30 \times 8} {12 \times 4} \\\\
= & 3                            &:& 8                             &:& \dfrac {3 \times 30 \times 8} {12 \times 4} \\\\

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If the mass of the alloy is $72 \ \text{kg}$, how much iron and tungsten does it contain?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If the mass of the alloy is $72 \ \text{kg}$, how much iron and tungsten does it contain?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the mass of iron $= a$

Mass of tungsten $= 72 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{kg} : 1 \ \text{kg}                   &= a \ \text{kg} : (72 - a) \ \text{kg} \\\\
\dfrac{5}{1}                                    &= \dfrac {a} {72 - a} \\\\
5 \times (72 - a)                               &= a \\\\
5 \times 72 - 5a                                &= a \\\\
360 - 5a                                        &= a \\\\
5a + a                                          &= 360 \\\\
6a                                              &= 360 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {360} {6} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 60} {6} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 60} {\cancel 6} \\\\
a                                               &= 60 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Mass of iron}         &= 60 \ \text{kg} \\\\
\text{Mass of tungsten}     &= 72 - 60 \\\\
                            &= 12 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{alloy}                  &:& \text{iron}                &:& \text{tungsten} \\\\
= & (5 + 1) \ \text{kg}           &:& 5 \ \text{kg}              &:& 1 \ \text{kg} \\\\
= & 6                             &:& 5                          &:& 1 \\\\
= & 6 \times 12                   &:& 5 \times 12                &:& 1 \times 12 \\\\
= & 72 \ \text{kg}                &:& 60 \ \text{kg}             &:& 12 \ \text{kg}
\end{array}
$

Mass of iron $= 60 \ \text{kg}$

Mass of tungsten $= 12 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$60 \ \text{kg}, 12 \ \text{kg}$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If there is $15 \ \text{kg}$ of iron in a quantity of the alloy, how much tungsten is there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If there is $15 \ \text{kg}$ of iron in a quantity of the alloy, how much tungsten is there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of tungsten $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{kg} : 1 \ \text{kg}                   &= 15 \ \text{kg} : a \ \text{kg} \\\\
5                                               &= \dfrac {15} {a} \\\\
5 \times a                                      &= 15 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {15} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times 3} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 3} {\cancel 5} \\\\
a                                               &= 3 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Tungsten $= 3 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{iron}                                 &:& \text{tungsten} \\\\
= & 5 \ \text{kg}                               &:& 1 \ \text{kg} \\\\
= & 1                                           &:& \dfrac {1} {5} \\\\
= & 1 \times 15                                 &:& \dfrac {15} {5} \\\\
= & 15                                          &:& \dfrac {5 \times 3} {5} \\\\
= & 15                                          &:& \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 3} {\cancel 5} \\\\
= & 15 \ \text{kg}                              &:& 3 \ \text{kg}
\end{array}
$

Tungsten $= 3 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$3 \ \text{kg}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Five bags of apples cost $\pounds 3.25$.

How much would seven bags of apples cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Five bags of apples cost $\pounds 3.25$.
<emptyline>
How much would seven bags of apples cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of one bag}        &= \dfrac {\pounds 3.25} {5} \\\\
\text{Cost of seven bags}     &= 7 \times \dfrac {3.25} {5} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {7 \times 3.25} {5} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {22.75} {5} \\\\
                              &= \pounds 4.55
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of seven bags of apples $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{apples} : \pounds 3.25                &= 7 \ \text{apples} : \pounds a \\\\
\dfrac {5} {3.25}                               &= \dfrac {7} {a} \\\\
5 \times a                                      &= 7 \times 3.25 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 3.25} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {22.75} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 4.55
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of apples $= \pounds 4.55$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{apples}       &:& \text{cost} \\\\
= & 5                   &:& \pounds 3.25 \\\\
= & 1                   &:& \dfrac {3.25} {5} \\\\
= & 1 \times 7          &:& \dfrac {3.25 \times 7} {5} \\\\
= & 7                   &:& \dfrac {22.75} {5} \\\\
= & 7                   &:& \pounds 4.55
\end{array}
$

Cost of apples $= \pounds 4.55$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 4.55$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A pile of hay can feed $12$ horses for $15 \ \text{days}$.

For how long could the same pile of hay feed $20$ horses? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A pile of hay can feed $12$ horses for $15 \ \text{days}$.
<emptyline>
For how long could the same pile of hay feed $20$ horses? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of days}     &= \dfrac {12 \times 15} {20} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {4 \times 3 \times 5 \times 3} {5 \times 4} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 3 \times \cancel 5 \times 3} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                          &= 3 \times 3 \\\\
                          &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The number of days is inversely proportional to the number of horses.

If more horses eat the same hay, it will finish sooner.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Days for 12 horses} &= 15 \\\\
\text{Days for 1 horse}   &= 12 \times 15 \\\\
\text{Days for 20 horses} &= \dfrac {12 \times 15} {20} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 5 \times 3} {5 \times 4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4 \times \cancel 5 \times 3} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                           &= 3 \times 3 \\\\
                           &= 9 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Time hay lasts $= 9 \ \text{days}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using inverse proportion (more horses, fewer days),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{horses}  &:& \text{days} \\\\
= & 12             &:& 15 \ \text{days} \\\\
= & 1              &:& 15 \times 12 \\\\
= & 20              &:& \dfrac {15 \times 12} {20} \\\\
= & 20              &:& \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 5 \times 3} {5 \times 4} \\\\
= & 20              &:& \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4 \times \cancel 5 \times 3} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
= & 20              &:& 3 \times 3 \\\\
= & 20              &:& 9 \ \text{days}
\end{array}
$

Time hay lasts $= 9 \ \text{days}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a group of $48$ children, the ratio of boys to girls is $3:5$.

How many boys must join the group to make the ratio of boys to girls $5 : 3?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a group of $48$ children, the ratio of boys to girls is $3:5$.
<emptyline>
How many boys must join the group to make the ratio of boys to girls $5 : 3?$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Original number of boys} &= 48 \times \dfrac {3} {3 + 5} \\\\
                              &= 48 \times \dfrac {3} {8} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac{48 \times 3} {8} \\\\
                              &= 6 \times 3 \\\\
                              &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

Let the number of boys that join the group $= a$

Using equivalent ratio for the new group,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{boys} : 3 \ \text{girls}            &= (18 + a) \ \text{boys} : 30 \ \text{girls} \\\\
\dfrac{5} {3}                              &= \dfrac{18 + a} {30} \\\\
3 \times (18 + a)                             &= 5 \times 30 \\\\
a + 18                                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 30} {3} \\\\
a + 18                                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 10 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a + 18                                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 10 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a + 18                                        &= 5 \times 10 \\\\
a + 18                                        &= 50 \\\\
a                                             &= 50 - 18 \\\\
a                                             &= 32
\end{aligned}
$

Number of boys that must join $= 32$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$32$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>

<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>

                              &= 48 \times \dfrac {3} {8} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac{48 \times 3} {8} \\\\
                              &= 6 \times 3 \\\\
                              &= 18
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>

<emptyline>

<emptyline>

\begin{aligned}

\dfrac{5} {3}                              &= \dfrac{18 + a} {30} \\\\
3 \times (18 + a)                             &= 5 \times 30 \\\\
a + 18                                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 30} {3} \\\\
a + 18                                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 10 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a + 18                                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 10 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a + 18                                        &= 5 \times 10 \\\\
a + 18                                        &= 50 \\\\
a                                             &= 50 - 18 \\\\
a                                             &= 32
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Number of boys that must join $= 32$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A pile of food can feed $12$ rabbits for $15 \ \text{days}$.

For how long could the same pile of food feed $20$ rabbits? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A pile of food can feed $12$ rabbits for $15 \ \text{days}$.
<emptyline>
For how long could the same pile of food feed $20$ rabbits? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The number of days the food lasts is inversely proportional to the number of rabbits.

If there are more rabbits, the food will last for fewer days.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Days for 12 rabbits} &= 15 \\\\
\text{Days for 1 rabbit}   &= 12 \times 15 \\\\
\text{Days for 20 rabbits} &= \dfrac {12 \times 15} {20} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 5 \times 3} {5 \times 4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4 \times \cancel 5 \times 3} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                           &= 3 \times 3 \\\\
                           &= 9 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Time food lasts $= 9 \ \text{days}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using inverse proportion (more rabbits, fewer days),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{rabbits}  &:& \text{days} \\\\
= & 12              &:& 15 \\\\
= & 1               &:& 15 \times 12 \\\\
= & 20              &:& \dfrac {15 \times 12} {20} \\\\
= & 20              &:& \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 5 \times 3} {5 \times 4} \\\\
= & 20              &:& \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4 \times \cancel 5 \times 3} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
= & 20              &:& 3 \times 3 \\\\
= & 20              &:& 9 \ \text{days}
\end{array}
$

Time food lasts $= 9 \ \text{days}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a class the ratio of boys to girls is $3 {:} 5$.

If there are $6$ less boys than girls, how any pupils are in the class in total? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a class the ratio of boys to girls is $3 {:} 5$.
<emptyline>
If there are $6$ less boys than girls, how any pupils are in the class in total? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of girls $= g$

Number of boys $= g - 6$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
(g - 6) \ \text{boys} : g \ \text{girls}        &= 3 \ \text{boys} : 5 \ \text{girls} \\\\
\dfrac {g - 6} {g}                              &= \dfrac {3} {5} \\\\
(g - 6) \times 5                                &= 3 \times g \\\\
5g - 30                                         &= 3g \\\\
5g - 3g                                         &= 30 \\\\
2g                                              &= 30 \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {30} {2} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {2 \times 15} {2} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 15} {\cancel 2} \\\\
g                                               &= 15
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of girls}      &= 15 \\\\
\text{Number of boys}       &= 15 - 6 \\\\
                            &= 9 \\\\
\text{Total pupils}         &= 15 + 9 \\\\
                            &= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{total pupils}                 &:& \text{difference (girls − boys)} \\\\
= & (3 + 5)                           &:& (5 - 3) \\\\
= & 8                                  &:& 2 \\\\
= & 8 \times 3                          &:& 2 \times 3  \\\\
= & 24                                  &:& 6
\end{array}
$

Total pupils $= 24$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%

<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the number of girls $= g$
<emptyline>
Number of boys $= g - 6$
<emptyline>
Using equivalent ratio,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
(g - 6) \ \text{boys} : g \ \text{girls}        &= 3 \ \text{boys} : 5 \ \text{girls} \\\\
\dfrac {g - 6} {g}                              &= \dfrac {3} {5} \\\\
(g - 6) \times 5                                &= 3 \times g \\\\
5g - 30                                         &= 3g \\\\
5g - 3g                                         &= 30 \\\\
2g                                              &= 30 \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {30} {2} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {2 \times 15} {2} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 15} {\cancel 2} \\\\
g                                               &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of girls}      &= 15 \\\\
\text{Number of boys}       &= 15 - 6 \\\\
                            &= 9 \\\\
\text{Total pupils}         &= 15 + 9 \\\\
                            &= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Bella makes purple paint by mixing blue paint and red paint in the ratio of $4 : 3$. How much blue paint is needed to make $21 \ \text{litres}$ of purple paint?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bella makes purple paint by mixing blue paint and red paint in the ratio of $4 : 3$. How much blue paint is needed to make $21 \ \text{litres}$ of purple paint?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of blue paint $= 4a$

Let the amount of red paint $= 3a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4a + 3a               &= 21 \\\\      
7a                    &= 21 \\\\
a                     &= \dfrac{21}{7} \\\\   
a                     &= 3 \\\\
\text{Blue paint}     &= 4a \\\\
                      &= 4 \times 3 \\\\
                      &= 12 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$

Blue paint needed $= 12 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the volume of blue paint $= b$

Volume of red paint $= 21 - b$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
b \ \text{litres} : (21 - b) \ \text{litres}       &= 4 \ \text{litres} : 3 \ \text{litres} \\\\
\dfrac {b} {21 - b}                                &= \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
3 \times b                                         &= 4 \times (21 - b) \\\\
3b                                                 &= 84 - 4b \\\\
3b + 4b                                            &= 84 \\\\
7b                                                 &= 84 \\\\
b                                                  &= \dfrac {84} {7} \\\\
b                                                  &= \dfrac {7 \times 12} {7} \\\\
b                                                  &= \dfrac {\cancel 7 \times 12} {\cancel 7} \\\\
b                                                  &= 12 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$

Blue paint needed $= 12 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{purple}                                &:& \text{blue} \\\\
= & (4 + 3) \ \text{litres}                      &:& 4 \ \text{litres} \\\\
= & 7                                            &:& 4 \\\\
= & 7 \times 3                                   &:& 4 \times 3 \\\\
= & 21 \ \text{litres}                           &:& 12 \ \text{litres}
\end{array}
$

Blue paint needed $= 12 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12 \ \text{litres}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

James draws a plan of his school using a scale of $1 \ \text{cm}$ to $6 \ \text{m}$. On the plan the playground is $5 \ \text{cm}$ long. What is the real length of the playground? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">James draws a plan of his school using a scale of $1 \ \text{cm}$ to $6 \ \text{m}$. On the plan the playground is $5 \ \text{cm}$ long. What is the real length of the playground? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the real length of playground $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{cm} : 6 \ \text{m}                    &= 5 \ \text{cm} : a \ \text{m} \\\\
\dfrac {1} {6}                                  &= \dfrac {5} {a} \\\\
1 \times a                                      &= 5 \times 6 \\\\
a                                               &= 30 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$

Real length of playground $= 30 \ \text{m}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

  & \text{plan} \ (\text{cm})         &:& \text{playground} \ (\text{m}) \\\\
= & 1 \ \text{cm}       &:& 6 \ \text{m} \\\\
= & 5                   &:& 6 \times 5 \\\\
= & 5 \ \text{cm}       &:& 30 \ \text{m}
\end{array}
$

Real length of playground $= 30 \ \text{m}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

She has $12 \ \text{litres}$ of red paint. How much blue paint will she need? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">She has $12 \ \text{litres}$ of red paint. How much blue paint will she need? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of blue paint she needed $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \ \text{litres} : 5 \ \text{litres}           &= 12 \ \text{litres} : a \ \text{litres} \\\\
\dfrac {4} {5}                                  &= \dfrac {12} {a} \\\\
4 \times a                                      &= 12 \times 5 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {12 \times 5} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {4 \times 3 \times 5} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 3 \times 5} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                               &= 3 \times 5 \\\\
a                                               &= 15 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$

Blue paint needed $= 15 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{red}          &:& \text{blue} \\\\
= & 4 \ \text{litres}   &:& 5 \ \text{litres} \\\\
= & 1                   &:& \dfrac{5} {4} \\\\
= & 1 \times 12         &:& \dfrac{5 \times 12} {4} \\\\
= & 12                  &:& \dfrac{5 \times 4 \times 3} {4} \\\\
= & 12                  &:& \dfrac{5 \times \cancel 4 \times 3} {\cancel 4} \\\\
= & 12                  &:& 5 \times 3 \\\\
= & 12 \ \text{litres}  &:& 15 \ \text{litres}
\end{array}
$

Blue paint needed $= 15 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15 \text{ litres}$

</div>

**Question**

Eliot needs $36 \ \text{litres}$ of purple paint. How much red paint will he need?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Eliot needs $36 \ \text{litres}$ of purple paint. How much red paint will he need?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the volume of red paint $= a$

Volume of blue paint $= 36 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \ \text{litres} : 5 \ \text{litres}           &= a \ \text{litres} : (36 - a) \ \text{litres} \\\\
\dfrac {4} {5}                                  &= \dfrac {a} {36 - a} \\\\
4 \times (36 - a)                               &= 5 \times a \\\\
4 \times 36 - 4a                                &= 5a \\\\
144 - 4a                                        &= 5a \\\\
144                                             &= 5a + 4a \\\\
5a + 4a                                         &= 144 \\\\
9a                                              &= 144 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {144} {9} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 16} {9} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 9 \times 16} {\cancel 9} \\\\
a                                               &= 16 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$

Red paint needed $= 16 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{purple}             &:& \text{red} \\\\
= & (4 + 5) \ \text{litres}   &:& 4 \ \text{litres} \\\\
= & 9                         &:& 4 \\\\
= & 9 \times 4                &:& 4 \times 4 \\\\
= & 36 \ \text{litres}        &:& 16 \ \text{litres}
\end{array}
$

Red paint needed $= 16 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$16 \text{ litres}$

**Question**

On the plan, the garden is $2  \ \text{cm}$ wide. What is the real width of the garden?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the actual width of garden $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{cm} : 12 \ \text{m}                   &= 2 \ \text{cm} : a \ \text{m} \\\\
\dfrac {1} {12}                                 &= \dfrac {2} {a} \\\\
1 \times a                                      &= 2 \times 12 \\\\
a                                               &= 24 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$

Real width of the garden $= 24 \ \text{m}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{plan}         &:& \text{garden} \\\\
= & 1 \ \text{cm}       &:& 12 \ \text{m} \\\\
= & 1 \times 2          &:& 12 \times 2 \\\\
= & 2 \ \text{cm}       &:& 24 \ \text{m}
\end{array}
$

Real width of the garden $= 24 \ \text{m}$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

'Purple Fire' paint is made by mixing red and blue paint in the ratio $3:1$. If I want to make $1 \ \text{litre}$ of 'Purple Fire' paint, how much red paint do I need?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">'Purple Fire' paint is made by mixing red and blue paint in the ratio $3:1$. If I want to make $1 \ \text{litre}$ of 'Purple Fire' paint, how much red paint do I need?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the volume of red paint (in ml) $= a$

Volume of blue paint $= 1000 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \ \text{ml} : 1 \ \text{ml}                   &= a \ \text{ml} : (1000 - a) \ \text{ml} \\\\
\dfrac {3} {1}                                  &= \dfrac {a} {1000 - a} \\\\
3 \times (1000 - a)                             &= a \\\\
3000 - 3a                                       &= a \\\\
a + 3a                                          &= 3000 \\\\
4a                                              &= 3000 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3000} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {4 \times 750} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 750} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                               &= 750 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

Red paint needed $= 750 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{purple}                               &:& \text{red} \\\\
= & (1 + 3) \ \text{ml}                         &:& 3 \ \text{ml} \\\\
= & 4                                           &:& 3 \\\\
= & 4 \times 250                                &:& 3 \times 250 \\\\
= & 1000 \ \text{ml}                            &:& 750 \ \text{ml} \\\\
= & 1 \ \text{litre}                            &:& 750 \ \text{ml}
\end{array}
$

Red paint needed $= 750 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$750 \ \text{ml}$ 

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A drink contains lime, orange and apple juices in the ratio $2:7:6$. Find the volume of orange juice contained in $300 \ \text{ml}$ of the drink.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A drink contains lime, orange and apple juices in the ratio $2:7:6$. Find the volume of orange juice contained in $300 \ \text{ml}$ of the drink.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the volume of orange juice $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
(2 + 7 + 6) \ \text{ml} : 7 \ \text{ml}         &= 300 \ \text{ml} : a \ \text{ml} \\\\
\dfrac {2 + 7 + 6} {7}                          &= \dfrac {300} {a} \\\\
\dfrac {15} {7}                                 &= \dfrac {300} {a} \\\\
15 \times a                                     &= 300 \times 7 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {300 \times 7} {15} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {20 \times 15 \times 7} {15} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {20 \times \cancel {15} \times 7} {\cancel {15}} \\\\
a                                               &= 20 \times 7 \\\\
a                                               &= 140 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

Orange juice $= 140 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{drink}              &:& \text{orange juice} \\\\
= & (2 + 7 + 6) \ \text{ml}   &:& 7 \ \text{ml} \\\\
= & 15                        &:& 7 \\\\
= & 15 \times 20              &:& 7 \times 20 \\\\
= & 300 \ \text{ml}           &:& 140 \ \text{ml}
\end{array}
$

Orange juice $= 140 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$140 \text { ml}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

How much water should be mixed with $30 \ \text{ml}$ of cordial?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the water mixed $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{ml} : 4 \ \text{ml}                   &= 30 \ \text{ml} : a \ \text{ml} \\\\
\dfrac {1} {4}                                  &= \dfrac {30} {a} \\\\
1 \times a                                      &= 30 \times 4 \\\\
a                                               &= 120 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

Amount of water $= 120 \ \text{ml}$

= & 1 \ \text{ml}                           &:& 4 \ \text{ml} \\\\
= & 1 \times 30                             &:& 4 \times 30 \\\\
= & 30 \ \text{ml}                          &:& 120 \ \text{ml}
\end{array}
$

Amount of water $= 120 \ \text{ml}$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much cordial should be used to make $750 \ \text{ml}$ of the drink?

<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let cordial used $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{ml} : 4 \ \text{ml}                   &= a \ \text{ml} : (750 - a) \ \text{ml} \\\\

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a fruit yoghurt weighing $117 \ \text{g}$, the ratio of weight of fruit to weight of yoghurt is $2:7$. Calculate the weight of fruit.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a fruit yoghurt weighing $117 \ \text{g}$, the ratio of weight of fruit to weight of yoghurt is $2:7$. Calculate the weight of fruit.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of fruit $= a$

Weight of yoghurt $= 117 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \ \text{g} : 7 \ \text{g}                     &= a \ \text{g} : (117 - a) \ \text{g} \\\\
\dfrac {2} {7}                                  &= \dfrac {a} {117 - a} \\\\
2 \times (117 - a)                              &= 7a \\\\
234 - 2a                                        &= 7a \\\\
2a + 7a                                         &= 234 \\\\
9a                                              &= 234 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {234} {9} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 26} {9} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 9 \times 26} {\cancel 9} \\\\
a                                               &= 26 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$

Weight of fruit $= 26 \ \text{g}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{fruit yoghurt}                        &:& \text{fruit} \\\\
= & (2 + 7) \ \text{g}                          &:& 2 \ \text{g} \\\\
= & 9                                           &:& 2 \\\\
= & 9 \times 13                                 &:& 2 \times 13 \\\\
= & 117 \ \text{g}                              &:& 26 \ \text{g}
\end{array}
$

Weight of fruit $= 26 \ \text{g}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$26 \ \text{g}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bottle of blackcurrant cordial makes enough drink to fill $60$ glasses when it is diluted in the ratio $1$ part cordial to $4$ parts water. 
How many glasses of drink would a bottle of cordial make if it is diluted in the ratio $1$ part cordial to $5$ parts water?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bottle of blackcurrant cordial makes enough drink to fill $60$ glasses when it is diluted in the ratio $1$ part cordial to $4$ parts water. 
How many glasses of drink would a bottle of cordial make if it is diluted in the ratio $1$ part cordial to $5$ parts water?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of cordial (measured as size of glass) $= a$

Number of glasses of water used $= 60 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1  : 4                                          &= a  : 60 - a  \\\\
\dfrac {1} {4}                                  &= \dfrac {a} {60 - a} \\\\
60 - a                                          &= 4a \\\\
60                                              &= 4a + a \\\\
4a + a                                          &= 60 \\\\
5a                                              &= 60 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {60} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times 12} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 12} {\cancel 5} \\\\
a                                               &= 12 \ \text{glasses}
\end{aligned}
$

Let's calculate now how many glasses of drink we can have with new ratios.

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{cordial}                          &:& \text{drink} \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& (1 + 5) \\\\
= & 1 \times 12                             &:& 6 \times 12 \\\\
= & 12                                      &:& 72 \ \text{glasses}
\end{array}
$

Number of glasses of drink $= 72$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$72$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

William changes $\pounds 240$ into Dollars at the beginning of his holiday. How many Dollars does he receive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of dollars he received $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 3 : \text{\textdollar} 5                &= \pounds 240 : \text{\textdollar} a \\\\
\dfrac{3} {5}                                   &= \dfrac {240} {a} \\\\
3 \times a                                      &= 240 \times 5 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {240 \times 5} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {80 \times 3 \times 5} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {80 \times \cancel 3 \times 5} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                                               &= 80 \times 5 \\\\
a                                               &= \text{\textdollar} 400
\end{aligned}
$

Dollars received $= \text{\textdollar} 400$

Dollars received $= \text{\textdollar} 400$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jason and Patrick win a prize of $\pounds 75$ for their entry into an inventing competition. For every $2 \ \text{hours}$ that Patrick worked on the project Jason worked $3$, so it is decided that for every $\pounds 2$ that Patrick receives Jason should receive $\pounds 3$. How much will Jason and Patrick receive? Write your 
answers in the boxes below. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jason and Patrick win a prize of $\pounds 75$ for their entry into an inventing competition. For every $2 \ \text{hours}$ that Patrick worked on the project Jason worked $3$, so it is decided that for every $\pounds 2$ that Patrick receives Jason should receive $\pounds 3$. How much will Jason and Patrick receive? Write your 
answers in the boxes below. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the money received by Jason $= a$

Money received by Patrick $= 75 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 2 : \pounds 3          &= \pounds (75 - a) : \pounds a \\\\
\dfrac {2} {3}                 &= \dfrac {75 - a} {a} \\\\
2a                             &= 3 \times (75 - a) \\\\
2a                             &= 225 - 3a \\\\
2a + 3a                        &= 225 \\\\
5a                             &= 225 \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac {225} {5} \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac {5 \times 45} {5} \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 45} {\cancel 5} \\\\
a                              &= \pounds 45
\end{aligned}
$

Money received by Jason $= \pounds 45$

Money received by Patrick $= 75 - 45 = \pounds 30$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
