<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{Total}                &:& \text{Patrick}              &:& \text{Jason} \\\\
= & \pounds (2 + 3)             &:& \pounds 2                   &:& \pounds 3 \\\\
= & 5                           &:& 2                           &:& 3 \\\\
= & 5 \times 15                 &:& 2 \times 15                 &:& 3 \times 15 \\\\
= & \pounds 75                  &:& \pounds 30                  &:& \pounds 45
\end{array}
$

Money received by Jason $= \pounds 45$

Money received by Patrick $= \pounds 30$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Jason $=$ $\pounds 45$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Patrick $=$ $\pounds 30$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On a ferry to France, I wanted to buy a large bar of Toblerone 
chocolate, which cost $\pounds 3$. How many Euros would I have to pay for 
it?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On a ferry to France, I wanted to buy a large bar of Toblerone 
chocolate, which cost $\pounds 3$. How many Euros would I have to pay for 
it?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the euros $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 1 : 1.2 \ \text{Euros}                  &= \pounds 3 : a \ \text{Euros} \\\\
\dfrac{1}{1.2}                                  &= \dfrac {3} {a} \\\\
a                                               &= 3 \times 1.2 \\\\
a                                               &= 3.6 \ \text{Euros}
\end{aligned}
$

Payment $= 3.6 \ \text{Euros}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \pounds                 &:& \text{Euros} \\\\
= & 1                       &:& 1.2 \\\\
= & 1 \times 3              &:& 1.2 \times 3 \\\\
= & \pounds 3               &:& 3.6 \ \text{Euros}
\end{array}
$

Payment $= 3.6 \ \text{Euros}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3.6 \ \text{Euro}$

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A certain bottle of wine in France costs $7.5 \ \text{Euros}$. How much is 
that in English pounds?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A certain bottle of wine in France costs $7.5 \ \text{Euros}$. How much is 
that in English pounds?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the pounds $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 1 : 1.2 \ \text{Euros}                  &= \pounds a : 7.5 \ \text{Euros} \\\\
\dfrac{1}{1.2}                                  &= \dfrac {a} {7.5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {7.5} {1.2} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {75} {12} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 25} {3 \times 4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 25} {\cancel{3} \times 4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {25} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 6.25
\end{aligned}
$

Cost $= \pounds 6.25$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

  & \pounds                                                 &:& \text{Euros} \\\\
= & 1                                                       &:& 1.2 \\\\

= & \dfrac {7.5} {1.2}                                      &:& 1 \times 7.5 \\\\

= & \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 25} {\cancel{3} \times 4}     &:& 7.5 \\\\
= & \pounds 6.25                                            &:& 7.5 \ \text{Euros}
\end{array}
$

Cost $= \pounds 6.25$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 6.25$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a country dance there are $3$ boys and $2$ girls in every line. 

$42$ boys take part in the dance. How many girls take part?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a country dance there are $3$ boys and $2$ girls in every line. 
<emptyline>
$42$ boys take part in the dance. How many girls take part?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of girls $= g$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \ \text{boys} : 2 \ \text{girls}              &= 42 \ \text{boys} : g \ \text{girls} \\\\
\dfrac{3}{2}                                    &= \dfrac {42} {g} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {42 \times 2} { 3} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {14 \times 3 \times 2} {3} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {14 \times \cancel{3} \times 2} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
g                                               &= 28
\end{aligned}
$

Number of girls $= 28$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{boys}     &:& \text{girls} \\\\
= & 3               &:& 2  \\\\
= & 3 \times 14     &:& 2 \times 14  \\\\
= & 42              &:& 28
\end{array}
$

Number of girls $= 28$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$28 \ \text{girls}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Eleven pencils cost $\pounds 4.95$. How much would seven pencils cost?

- $\pounds 3.50$
- $\pounds 3.20$
- $\pounds 4.00$
- $\pounds 3.15$
- $\pounds 4.15$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Eleven pencils cost $\pounds 4.95$. How much would seven pencils cost?
<emptyline>
- $\pounds 3.50$
- $\pounds 3.20$
- $\pounds 4.00$
- $\pounds 3.15$
- $\pounds 4.15$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 pencil}                       &= \dfrac {4.95} {11} \\\\
                                              &= 0.45 \\\\
\text{Cost of 7 pencils}                      &= 7 \times 0.45 \\\\
                                              &= \pounds 3.15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of seven pencils $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
11 \ \text{pencils} : \pounds 4.95              &= 7 \ \text{pencils} : \pounds a  \\\\
\dfrac {11} {4.95}                              &= \dfrac {7} {a} \\\\
11 \times a                                     &= 7 \times 4.95 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 4.95} {11} \\\\
a                                               &= 7 \times 0.45 \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 3.15
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of $7$ pencils $= \pounds 3.15$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{pencils}                &:& \text{cost} \\\\
= & 11                            &:& \pounds 4.95 \\\\
= & 1                             &:& \dfrac{4.95} {11} \\\\
= & 1 \times 7                    &:& 7 \times \dfrac{4.95} {11} \\\\
= & 7                             &:& 7 \times 0.45 \\\\
= & 7                             &:& \pounds 3.15
\end{array}
$

Cost of $7$ pencils $= \pounds 3.15$
</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 3.15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $750 \ \text{grams}$ of pasta cost $90 \ \text{p}$ find the cost of $1 \ \text{kilogram}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $750 \ \text{grams}$ of pasta cost $90 \ \text{p}$ find the cost of $1 \ \text{kilogram}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 gram pasta}         &= \dfrac {90} {750} \\\\
\text{Cost of 1000 gram pasta}      &= \dfrac {90} {750} \times 1000 \\\\
\text{Cost of 1 kilogram pasta}     &= \dfrac {90 \times 1000} {750} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {30 \times 3 \times 250 \times 4} {250 \times 3} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {30 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel {250} \times 4} {\cancel {250} \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                                    &= 30 \times 4 \\\\
                                    &= 120 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 1.20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let price of pasta $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
750 \ \text{grams} : 90 \ \text{pence}          &= 1000 \ \text{grams} : a \ \text{pence} \\\\
\dfrac{750} {90}                                &= \dfrac {1000} {a} \\\\
750 \times a                                    &= 90 \times 1000 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {90 \times 1000} {750} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 30 \times 250 \times 4} {3 \times 250} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 30 \times \cancel {250} \times 4} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel {250}} \\\\
a                                               &= 30 \times 4 \\\\
a                                               &= 120 \ \text{pence} \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 1.20
\end{aligned}
$

Price of $1 \ \text{kilogram}$ of pasta $= 120 \ \text{p}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{pasta}                                  &:& \text{cost} \\\\
= & 750 \ \text{g}                                &:& 90 \ \text{p} \\\\
= & 1                                             &:& \dfrac {90} {750} \\\\
= & 1 \times 1000 \ \text{g}                      &:& \dfrac {90 \times 1000} {750} \\\\
= & 1 \ \text{kg}                                 &:& \dfrac {3 \times 30 \times 250 \times 4} {3 \times 250} \\\\
= & 1                                             &:& \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 30 \times \cancel {250} \times 4} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel {250}} \\\\
= & 1                                             &:& 30 \times 4 \\\\
= & 1                                             &:& 120 \ \text{p} \\\\
= & 1 \ \text{kg}                                 &:& \pounds 1.20
\end{array}
$

Price of $1 \ \text{kilogram}$ of pasta $= \pounds 1.20$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.20$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of centimetres $= a$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Measurement in inches}   & = 9 \ \text{feet} \ 10 \ \text{inches} \\\\
                                & = 9 \times 12 \ \text{inches} + 10 \ \text{inches} \\\\
                                &= 108 + 10 \\\\
                                &= 118 \ \text{inches}
\end{aligned}
$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
12 \ \text{inches} : 30 \ \text{cm}             &= 118 \ \text{inches} : a \ \text{cm} \\\\
\dfrac {12} {30}                                &= \dfrac {118} {a} \\\\
12a                                             &= 118 \times 30 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {118 \times 30} {12} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {2 \times 59 \times 6 \times 5} {2 \times 6} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 59 \times \cancel 6 \times 5} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 6} \\\\
a                                               &= 59 \times 5 \\\\
a                                               &= 295 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Number of centimetres in $118 \ \text{inches} = 295 \ \text{cm}$

= & 118                         &:& 5 \times 59 \\\\
= & 118 \ \text{inches}         &:& 295 \ \text{cm}
\end{array}
$

Number of centimetres in $118 \ \text{inches} = 295 \ \text{cm}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The drink "Raspberry Heaven" is $1$ part raspberry juice, $2$ parts orange juice and $3$ parts apple juice. 
How much raspberry juice does a $300 \ \text{ml}$ glass of Raspberry Heaven contain?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The drink "Raspberry Heaven" is $1$ part raspberry juice, $2$ parts orange juice and $3$ parts apple juice. 
How much raspberry juice does a $300 \ \text{ml}$ glass of Raspberry Heaven contain?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{raspberry heaven}                 &:& \text{raspberry juice} \\\\
= & (1 + 2 + 3) \ \text{ml}                 &:& 1 \ \text{ml} \\\\
= & 6                                       &:& 1 \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
= & 300                                     &:& \dfrac {300} {6} \\\\
= & 300                                     &:& \dfrac {6 \times 50} {6} \\\\
= & 300                                     &:& \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 50} {\cancel 6} \\\\
= & 300 \ \text{ml}                         &:& 50 \ \text{ml}
\end{array}
$

Volume of Raspberry juice $= 50 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$50 \ \text{ml}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If a dozen eggs cost $\pounds 2.80$, how much do $18$ eggs cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If a dozen eggs cost $\pounds 2.80$, how much do $18$ eggs cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 egg}      &= \dfrac {\pounds 2.8} {12} \\\\
\text{Cost of 18 egg}     &= 18 \times \dfrac {2.8} {12} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {18 \times 2.8} {12} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {18 \times 28} {12 \times 10} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {6 \times 3 \times 7 \times 4} {3 \times 4 \times 10} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel 3 \times 7 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 4 \times 10} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {6 \times 7} {10} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {42} {10} \\\\
                          &= \pounds 4.2
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of $18$ eggs $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
12 \ \text{eggs} : \pounds 2.8                  &= 18 \ \text{eggs} : \pounds a \\\\
\dfrac {12} {2.8}                                &= \dfrac {18} {a} \\\\
12a                                             &= 18 \times 2.8 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {18 \times 2.8} {12} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {18 \times 28} {12 \times 10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 3 \times 2 \times 14} {6 \times 2 \times 10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 3 \times \cancel 2 \times 14} {\cancel 6 \times \cancel 2 \times 10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 14} {10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {42} {10} \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 4.2
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of $18$ eggs $= \pounds 4.2$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{eggs}                 &:& \text{cost} \\\\
= & 12                          &:& \pounds 2.80 \\\\
= & 1                           &:& \dfrac {2.8} {12} \\\\
= & 1 \times 18                 &:& \dfrac {2.8 \times 18} {12} \\\\
= & 18                          &:& \dfrac {28 \times 18} {12 \times 10} \\\\
= & 18                          &:& \dfrac {2 \times 14 \times 3 \times 6} {2 \times 6 \times 10} \\\\
= & 18                          &:& \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 14 \times 3 \times \cancel 6} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 6 \times 10} \\\\
= & 18                          &:& \dfrac {14 \times 3} {10} \\\\
= & 18                          &:& \dfrac {42} {10} \\\\
= & 18                          &:& \pounds 4.2
\end{array}
$

Cost of $18$ eggs $= \pounds 4.2$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 4.2$

</div>
</div>

<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the cost of $18$ eggs $= a$
<emptyline>
Using equivalent ratio,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
12 \ \text{eggs} : \pounds 2.8                  &= 18 \ \text{eggs} : \pounds a \\\\
\dfrac {12} {2.8}                                &= \dfrac {18} {a} \\\\
12a                                             &= 18 \times 2.8 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {18 \times 2.8} {12} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {18 \times 28} {12 \times 10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 3 \times 2 \times 14} {6 \times 2 \times 10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 3 \times \cancel 2 \times 14} {\cancel 6 \times \cancel 2 \times 10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 14} {10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {42} {10} \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 4.2
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Cost of $18$ eggs $= \pounds 4.2$
</code></pre>

If he uses $6 \ \text{litres}$ of red paint, how much blue paint should he use? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</code></pre>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the blue paint needed $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \ \text{litres} : 3 \ \text{litres}           &= 6 \ \text{litres} : a \ \text{litres} \\\\
\dfrac {2} {3}                                  &= \dfrac {6} {a} \\\\
2 \times a                                      &= 6 \times 3 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 3} {2} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 3} {2} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 3 \times 3} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a                                               &= 3 \times 3 \\\\
a                                               &= 9 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$

Blue paint needed $= 9 \ \text{litres}$

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much blue paint is needed to make $35 \ \text{litres}$ of purple paint?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much blue paint is needed to make $35 \ \text{litres}$ of purple paint?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let amount of blue paint used $= a$

Amount of red paint used $= 35 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \ \text{litres} : 3 \ \text{litres}           &= (35 - a) \ \text{litres} : a \ \text{litres} \\\\
\dfrac{2} {3}                                   &= \dfrac {35 - a} {a} \\\\
2 \times a                                      &= (35 - a) \times 3 \\\\
2a                                              &= 35 \times 3 - 3a \\\\
2a                                              &= 105 - 3a \\\\
2a + 3a                                         &= 105 \\\\
5a                                              &= 105 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {105} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times 21} {5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 21} {\cancel 5} \\\\
a                                               &= 21 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$

Blue paint needed $= 21 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{purple paint}                     &:& \text{blue paint} \\\\
= & (2 + 3) \ \text{litres}                 &:& 3 \ \text{litres} \\\\
= & 5                                       &:& 3 \\\\
= & 5 \times 7                              &:& 3 \times 7 \\\\
= & 35 \ \text{litres}                      &:& 21 \ \text{litres}
\end{array}
$

Blue paint needed $= 21 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21 \ \text {litres}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

At a supermarket $3  \ \text{kilograms}$ of apples costs $\pounds 12$.

How much does $18  \ \text{kilograms}$ of apples cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">At a supermarket $3  \ \text{kilograms}$ of apples costs $\pounds 12$.

</code></pre>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 kilogram}                     &= \dfrac {12} {3} \\\\
\text{Cost of 18 kilograms}                   &= 18 \times \dfrac {12} {3} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {18 \times 12} {3} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {6 \times 3 \times 12} {3} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel 3 \times 12} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                              &= 6 \times 12 \\\\
                                              &= \pounds 72
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of apples $= \pounds 72$

a                         &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 6 \times 12} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                         &= 6 \times 12 \\\\
a                         &= \pounds 72
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of apples $= \pounds 72$

How much does $4  \ \text{kilograms}$ of oranges cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 kilogram}                     &= \dfrac {14} {10} \\\\
\text{Cost of 4 kilograms}                    &= 4 \times \dfrac {14} {10} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {4 \times 14} {10} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {56} {10} \\\\
                                              &= \pounds 5.60
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
10 \ \text{kg} : \pounds 14 &= 4 \ \text{kg} : \pounds a \\\\

10 \times a                &= 4 \times 14 \\\\
a                         &= \dfrac {4 \times 14} {10} \\\\
a                         &= \dfrac {56} {10} \\\\
a                         &= \pounds 5.60
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of oranges $= \pounds 5.60$

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$3$ fully open taps fill up a bath in $60 \ \text{seconds}$. 

How long will $2$ fully open taps take to fill up the same bath?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$3$ fully open taps fill up a bath in $60 \ \text{seconds}$. 
<emptyline>
How long will $2$ fully open taps take to fill up the same bath?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The time taken is inversely proportional to the number of taps. 

If there are more taps, the time taken is less and vice versa.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time for 3 taps}  &= 60 \\\\
\text{Time for 1 tap}  &= 3 \times 60 \\\\
\text{Time for 2 taps} &= \dfrac {3 \times 60} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {3 \times 30 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 3 \times 30} {\cancel 2} \\\\
                      &= 3 \times 30 \\\\
                      &= 90 \ \text{seconds}
\end{aligned}
$

Time taken $= 90 \ \text{seconds}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio (inverse proportion),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{taps}     &:& \text{time} \\\\
= & 3               &:& 60 \ \text{s} \\\\
= & 1               &:& 60 \times 3 \\\\
= & 2               &:& \dfrac {60 \times 3} {2} \\\\
= & 2               &:& \dfrac {30 \times 2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
= & 2               &:& \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 3 \times 30} {\cancel 2} \\\\
= & 2               &:& 3 \times 30 \\\\
= & 2               &:& 90 \ \text{s}
\end{array}
$

Time taken $= 90 \ \text{seconds}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jenny pays $\pounds 156$ for six nights Bed and Breakfast accommodation. How much would it cost her to stay there for $8$ nights?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jenny pays $\pounds 156$ for six nights Bed and Breakfast accommodation. How much would it cost her to stay there for $8$ nights?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount paid for one night}    &= \dfrac {156} {6} \\\\
\text{Amount paid for eight nights} &= 8 \times \dfrac {156} {6} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {8 \times 156} {6} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {8 \times 6 \times 26} {6} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {8 \times \cancel 6 \times 26} {\cancel 6} \\\\
                                    &= 8 \times 26 \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 208
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost to stay for $8$ nights $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
6 \ \text{nights} : \pounds 156                 &= 8 \ \text{nights} : \pounds a \\\\
\dfrac {6} {156}                                &= \dfrac {8} {a} \\\\
6a                                              &= 8 \times 156 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {8 \times 156} {6} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {8 \times 26 \times 6} {6} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {8 \times 26 \times \cancel 6} {\cancel 6} \\\\
a                                               &= 8 \times 26 \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 208
\end{aligned}
$

Cost to stay for $8$ nights $= \pounds 208$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{nights}               &:& \pounds \\\\
= & 6                           &:& 156 \\\\
= & 1                           &:& \dfrac {156} {6} \\\\
= & 1 \times 8                  &:& \dfrac {156 \times 8} {6} \\\\
= & 8                           &:& \dfrac {6 \times 26 \times 8} {6} \\\\
= & 8                           &:& \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 26 \times 8} {\cancel 6} \\\\
= & 8                           &:& 26 \times 8 \\\\
= & 8                           &:& \pounds 208
\end{array}
$

Cost to stay for $8$ nights $= \pounds 208$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 208$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

May is $14 \ \text{years}$ old and her father is $39 \ \text{years}$ older than her. 
May's mother is $8 \ \text{years}$ younger than her father. How old is May's mother?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">May is $14 \ \text{years}$ old and her father is $39 \ \text{years}$ older than her. 
May's mother is $8 \ \text{years}$ younger than her father. How old is May's mother?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Father's age} &= 14 + 39 \\\\
                    &= 53 \ \text{years} \\\\
\text{Mother's age} &= 53 - 8 \\\\
                    &= 45 \ \text{years}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$45 \ \text{years}$

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Five glass marbles cost a total of $\pounds 7.50$. How many marbles could I buy with $\pounds 24?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Five glass marbles cost a total of $\pounds 7.50$. How many marbles could I buy with $\pounds 24?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Marbles in \pounds 1}   &= \dfrac {5} {7.5} \\\\
\text{Marbles in \pounds 24} &= 24 \times \dfrac {5} {7.5} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {24 \times 5} {7.5} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {24 \times 5 \times 10} {75} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {3 \times 8 \times 5 \times 5 \times 2} {5 \times 5 \times 3} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 8 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                                      &= 8 \times 2 \\\\
                                      &= 16
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of marbles $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 7.5 : 5 \ \text{marbles}                &= \pounds 24 : a \ \text{marbles} \\\\
\dfrac {7.5} {5}                                &= \dfrac {24} {a} \\\\
7.5 \times a                                    &= 24 \times 5 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {24 \times 5} {7.5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {24 \times 5 \times 10} {75} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 8 \times 5 \times 5 \times 2} {5 \times 5 \times 3} \\\\
a                                      &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 8 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
a                                               &= 8 \times 2 \\\\
a                                               &= 16
\end{aligned}
$

Number of marbles $= 16$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{cost}                             &:& \text{marbles} \\\\
= & \pounds 7.5                             &:& 5 \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& \dfrac {5} {7.5} \\\\
= & 1 \times 24                             &:& \dfrac {24 \times 5} {7.5} \\\\
= & 24                                      &:& \dfrac {24 \times 5 \times 10} {75} \\\\
= & 24                                      &:& \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 5 \times 5 \times 2} {3 \times 5 \times 5} \\\\
= & 24                                      &:& \dfrac {8 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times 2} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
= & 24                                      &:& 8 \times 2 \\\\
= & \pounds 24                              &:& 16
\end{array}
$

Number of marbles $= 16$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$16$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Disc $B$ turns twice when $A$ turns $5$ times. If disc $A$ turns $45$ times, how many times does disc $B$ turn?

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2009/group-2/s01-q14-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2009/group-2/s01-q14-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2009/group-2/s01-q14-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Disc $B$ turns twice when $A$ turns $5$ times. If disc $A$ turns $45$ times, how many times does disc $B$ turn?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of times disc B turned $= b$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{disc A} : 2 \ \text{disc B}           &= 45 \ \text{disc A} : b \ \text{disc B} \\\\
\dfrac{5} {2}                                   &= \dfrac {45} {b} \\\\
5 \times b                                      &= 45 \times 2 \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {45 \times 2} {5} \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 5 \times 2} {5} \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel 5 \times 2} {\cancel 5} \\\\
b                                               &= 9 \times 2 \\\\
b                                               &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

Number of times disc B turned $= 18$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{disc A}                         &:& \text{disc B} \\\\
= & 5                                     &:& 2 \\\\
= & 1                                     &:& \dfrac{2} {5} \\\\
= & 1 \times 45                           &:& \dfrac{2 \times 45} {5} \\\\
= & 45                                    &:& \dfrac{2 \times 5 \times 9} {5} \\\\
= & 45                                    &:& \dfrac{2 \times \cancel 5 \times 9} {\cancel 5} \\\\
= & 45                                    &:& 2 \times 9 \\\\
= & 45                                    &:& 18
\end{array}
$

Number of times disc B turned $= 18$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$18$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Justin wants to make some bird tables to raise money for a charity. 
To make $4$ bird tables he needs:

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q14-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q14-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q14-i00.png")

$16 \ \text{metres}$ of wood

$4$ wooden trays

$64$ nails.

Write out the list of materials he would need to make $10$ bird tables.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Justin wants to make some bird tables to raise money for a charity. 
To make $4$ bird tables he needs:
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
$16 \ \text{metres}$ of wood
<emptyline>
$4$ wooden trays
<emptyline>
$64$ nails.
<emptyline>
Write out the list of materials he would need to make $10$ bird tables.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{bird tables}  &:& \text{wooden trays}                           &:& \text{wood}                                           &:& \text{nails} \\\\
= & 4                   &:& 4                                             &:& 16 \ \text{m}                                         &:& 64 \\\\
= & 1                   &:& \dfrac {4} {4}                                &:& \dfrac {16} {4}                                       &:& \dfrac {64} {4} \\\\
= & 1 \times 10         &:& \dfrac {4 \times 10} {4}                      &:& \dfrac {16 \times 10} {4}                             &:& \dfrac {64 \times 10} {4} \\\\
= & 10                  &:& \dfrac {4 \times 10} {4}                      &:& \dfrac {4 \times 4 \times 10} {4}                     &:& \dfrac {4 \times 16 \times 10} {4} \\\\
= & 10                  &:& \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 10} {\cancel 4}      &:& \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 4 \times 10} {\cancel 4}     &:& \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 16 \times 10} {\cancel 4} \\\\
= & 10                  &:& 10                                            &:& 4 \times 10                                           &:& 16 \times 10 \\\\
= & 10                  &:& 10                                            &:& 40 \ \text{m}                                         &:& 160 \\\\
\end{array}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

wooden trays $=$ $10$

**Answer**

wood $=$ $40 \ \text{m}$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

nails $=$ $160$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How long would the greenfly last if there were only $6$ ladybirds?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How long would the greenfly last if there were only $6$ ladybirds?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If there are **fewer** ladybirds, it will take **more time** for the greenfly to be eaten. So time is **inversely** proportional to ladybirds.

$\text{time} \propto \dfrac{1}{\text{ladybirds}}$

Let the time $= t$

Using equivalent ratio (inverse proportion with ladybirds),

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \ \text{hours} : 9 \ \text{ladybirds} &= t \ \text{hours} : 6 \ \text{ladybirds} \\\\
\dfrac{4}{t}                            &= \dfrac{6}{9} \\\\
t                                       &= \dfrac{9 \times 4}{6} \\\\
t                                       &= \dfrac{3 \times 3 \times 2 \times 2}{3 \times 2} \\\\
t                                       &= \dfrac{\cancel 3 \times 3 \times 2 \times \cancel 2}{\cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
t                                       &= 3 \times 2 \\\\
t                                       &= 6 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$

Time the greenfly will last $= 6 \ \text{hours}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If there are **fewer** ladybirds, it will take **more time** for the greenfly to be eaten. So time is **inversely** proportional to ladybirds.

$\text{time} \propto \dfrac{1}{\text{ladybirds}}$

Using ratio (inverse proportion with ladybirds),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccc}
  & \text{ladybirds}   &:& \text{hours} \\\\
= & 9                  &:& 4 \\\\
= & 1                  &:& 4 \times 9 \\\\
= & 1 \times 6         &:& \dfrac{4 \times 9}{6} \\\\
= & 6                  &:& \dfrac{2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 3}{3 \times 2} \\\\
= & 6                  &:& \dfrac{2 \times \cancel 2 \times 3 \times \cancel 3}{\cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
= & 6                  &:& 2 \times 3 \\\\
= & 6                  &:& 6 \ \text{hours}
\end{array}
$

Time the greenfly will last $= 6 \ \text{hours}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6 \ \text{hours}$

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many bushes would be needed to feed $36$ ladybirds for $2 \ \text{hours}$?

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q41-s02-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q41-s02-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q41-s02-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many bushes would be needed to feed $36$ ladybirds for $2 \ \text{hours}$?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

From the main statement, one bush provides enough greenfly for $9$ ladybirds for $4 \ \text{hours}$.

If there are **more** bushes, it will take **more** ladybirds to eat the greenfly. So bushes are directly proportional to ladybirds.

If there are **more** bushes, it will take **more** time to eat the greenfly. So bushes are directly proportional to time.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{bushes} &\propto \text{ladybirds} \\\\
\text{bushes} & \propto \text{time} \\\\
\text{bushes} & \propto \text{ladybirds} \times \text{time}
\end{aligned}
$

Let number of bushes $= b$

Using compound ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{bush} : 9 \ \text{ladybirds} : 4 \ \text{hours} &= b \ \text{bushes} : 36 \ \text{ladybirds} : 2 \ \text{hours} \\\\
\dfrac{b}{1}                                              &= \dfrac{36}{9} \times \dfrac{2}{4} \\\\
b                                                         &= \dfrac{36 \times 2}{9 \times 4} \\\\
b                                                         &= \dfrac{4 \times 9 \times 2}{9 \times 4} \\\\
b                                                         &= \dfrac{\cancel 9 \times 4 \times 2}{\cancel 9 \times 4} \\\\
b                                                         &= 2
\end{aligned}
$

Number of bushes needed $= 2$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

From the main statement, one bush provides enough greenfly for $9$ ladybirds for $4 \ \text{hours}$.

If there are **more** bushes, it will take **more** ladybirds to eat the greenfly. So bushes are directly proportional to ladybirds.

If there are **more** bushes, it will take **more** time to eat the greenfly. So bushes are directly proportional to time.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{bushes} &\propto \text{ladybirds} \\\\
\text{bushes} & \propto \text{time} \\\\
\text{bushes} & \propto \text{ladybirds} \times \text{time}
\end{aligned}
$

Using compound ratio (direct proportion with ladybirds and time constant),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{ladybirds} &:& \text{time} &:& \text{bushes} \\\\
= & 9                &:& 4            &:& 1 \\\\
= & 1                &:& 4            &:& \dfrac{1}{9} \\\\
= & 1 \times 36      &:& 4            &:& \dfrac{1}{9} \times 36 \\\\
= & 36               &:& 4            &:& \dfrac{36}{9}
\end{array}
$

Using compound ratio (direct proportion with time and ladybirds kept constant),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{ladybirds} &:& \text{time} &:& \text{bushes} \\\\
= & 36               &:& 4            &:& \dfrac{36}{9} \\\\
= & 36               &:& 1            &:& \dfrac{36}{9 \times 4} \\\\
= & 36               &:& 1 \times 2   &:& \dfrac{36 \times 2}{9 \times 4} \\\\
= & 36               &:& 2            &:& \dfrac{9 \times 4 \times 2}{9 \times 4} \\\\
= & 36               &:& 2            &:& \dfrac{9 \times 4 \times 2}{9 \times 4} \\\\
= & 36               &:& 2            &:& \dfrac{\cancel 9 \times \cancel 4 \times 2}{\cancel 9 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
= & 36               &:& 2            &:& 2 \\\\
\end{array}
$

Number of bushes needed $= 2$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">From the main statement, one bush provides enough greenfly for $9$ ladybirds for $4 \ \text{hours}$.
<emptyline>
If there are **more** bushes, it will take **more** ladybirds to eat the greenfly. So bushes are directly proportional to ladybirds.
<emptyline>
If there are **more** bushes, it will take **more** time to eat the greenfly. So bushes are directly proportional to time.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{bushes} &\propto \text{ladybirds} \\\\
\text{bushes} & \propto \text{time} \\\\
\text{bushes} & \propto \text{ladybirds} \times \text{time}
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Let number of bushes $= b$
<emptyline>
Using compound ratio,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{bush} : 9 \ \text{ladybirds} : 4 \ \text{hours} &= b \ \text{bushes} : 36 \ \text{ladybirds} : 2 \ \text{hours} \\\\
\dfrac{b}{1}                                              &= \dfrac{36}{9} \times \dfrac{2}{4} \\\\
b                                                         &= \dfrac{36 \times 2}{9 \times 4} \\\\
b                                                         &= \dfrac{4 \times 9 \times 2}{9 \times 4} \\\\
b                                                         &= \dfrac{\cancel 9 \times 4 \times 2}{\cancel 9 \times 4} \\\\
b                                                         &= 2
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Number of bushes needed $= 2$
</code></pre>
</div>

**Question**

$12$ cats eat $\ldots$ cans of food in $3$ days.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If there are **fewer** cats, fewer cans will be eaten in the same time. So cans is **directly** proportional to cats.

Let cans $= c$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
48 \ \text{cats} : 12 \ \text{cans} &= 12 \ \text{cats} : c \ \text{cans} \\\\
\dfrac{48}{12} &= \dfrac{12}{c} \\\\
48 \times c &= 12 \times 12 \\\\
c &= \dfrac{12 \times 12}{48} \\\\
c &= \dfrac{3 \times 4 \times 12}{4 \times 12} \\\\
c &= \dfrac{3 \times \cancel{4} \times \cancel{12}}{\cancel{4} \times \cancel{12}} \\\\
c &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

Number of cans $= 3$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio (direct proportion with cats),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccc}
  & \text{cats}        &:& \text{cans} \\\\
= & 48                 &:& 12 \\\\
= & 1                  &:& \dfrac{12}{48} \\\\
= & 12 \times 1        &:& \dfrac{12 \times 12}{48} \\\\
= & 12                 &:& \dfrac{3 \times 4 \times 12}{4 \times 12} \\\\
= & 12                 &:& \dfrac{3 \times \cancel{4} \times \cancel{12}}{\cancel{4} \times \cancel{12}} \\\\
= & 12                 &:& 3
\end{array}
$

Number of cans $= 3$
</div>
</div>

**Working**

If there are **more** cans, it will take **more** days to finish. So cans is directly proportional to days.

Let the number of days $= d$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
12 \ \text{cans} : 3 \ \text{days} &= 24 \ \text{cans} : d \ \text{days} \\\\
\dfrac{12}{3} &= \dfrac{24}{d} \\\\
12 \times d &= 24 \times 3 \\\\
d &= \dfrac{24 \times 3}{12} \\\\
d &= \dfrac{2 \times 12 \times 3}{12} \\\\
d &= \dfrac{2 \times \cancel{12} \times 3}{\cancel{12}} \\\\
d &= 2 \times 3 \\\\
d &= 6 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Time taken $= 6 \ \text{days}$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$24$ cats eat 
$\text{\textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore}$
cans of food in $18 \ \text{days}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$24$ cats eat 
$\text{\textunderscore \textunderscore \textunderscore}$
cans of food in $18 \ \text{days}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If there are **more** cans, it will take **more** days to finish. So cans is directly proportional to days.

If there are **fewer** cats, fewer cans will be eaten in the same time. So cans is directly proportional to cats.

Using that,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{cans} &\propto \text{cats} \\\\
\text{cans} & \propto \text{days} \\\\
\text{cans} & \propto \text{cats} \times \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Using compound ratio (direct proportion with cats and days):

Let cans $= c$

Using compound ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
12 \ \text{cans} : 48 \ \text{cats} : 3 \ \text{days} &= c \ \text{cans} : 24 \ \text{cats} : 18 \ \text{days} \\\\
\dfrac{c}{12} &= \dfrac{24}{48} \times \dfrac{18}{3} \\\\
c &= \dfrac{12 \times 24 \times 18}{48 \times 3} \\\\
c &= \dfrac{12 \times 24 \times 3 \times 3 \times 2}{24 \times 2 \times 3} \\\\
c &= \dfrac{12 \times \cancel {24} \times 3 \times \cancel {3} \times \cancel{2}}{\cancel {24} \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
c &= 12 \times 3 \\\\
c &= 36
\end{aligned}
$

Number of cans $= 36$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio (direct proportion with cats and days), done in two steps:

Step $1$: Using compound ratio, direct proportion with cats (days constant),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{cats} &:& \text{days} &:& \text{cans} \\\\
= & 48          &:& 3           &:& 12 \\\\
= & 1           &:& 3           &:& \dfrac{12}{48} \\\\
= & 24 \times 1 &:& 3           &:& 24 \times \dfrac{12}{48} \\\\
= & 24          &:& 3           &:& \dfrac{12 \times 24}{48}
\end{array}
$

Step $2$: Using compound ratio, direct proportion with days (cats constant),

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
& \text{cats} &:& \text{days} &:& \text{cans} \\\\
= & 24          &:& 3           &:& \dfrac{12 \times 24}{48} \\\\
= & 24          &:& 1           &:& \dfrac{12 \times 24}{48 \times 3} \\\\
= & 24          &:& 18 \times 1 &:& \dfrac{12 \times 24 \times 18}{48 \times 3} \\\\
= & 24          &:& 18          &:& \dfrac{12 \times 24 \times 3 \times 3 \times 2}{24 \times 2 \times 3} \\\\
= & 24          &:& 18          &:& \dfrac{12 \times \cancel {24} \times 3 \times \cancel {3} \times \cancel{2}}{\cancel {24} \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
= & 24          &:& 18          &:& 12 \times 3 \\\\
= & 24          &:& 18          &:& 36 \ \text{cans}
\end{array}
$

Number of cans $= 36$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$36 \ \text{cans}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many stickers can be bought for $\pounds 2.40?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many stickers can be bought for $\pounds 2.40?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 sticker}            &= \dfrac {40} {3} \ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Number of stickers} &= \dfrac {\text{Total money}}{\text{Cost of 1 sticker}} \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 2.40 \div \dfrac {40} {3} \ \text{p} \\\\
                                    &= 240 \ \text{p} \div \dfrac {40} {3} \ \text{p} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {240 \times 3} {40} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {40 \times 6 \times 3} {40} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {40} \times 6 \times 3} {\cancel {40}} \\\\
                                    &= 3 \times 6 \\\\
                                    &= 18
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of stickers $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
40 \ \text{p} : 3 \ \text{stickers}               &= 2.40 \times 100 \ \text{p} : a \ \text{stickers} \\\\
\dfrac{40} {3}                                  &= \dfrac {240} {a} \\\\
40 \times a                                     &= 240 \times 3 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {240 \times 3} {40} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {40 \times 6 \times 3} {40} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel {40} \times 6 \times 3} {\cancel {40}} \\\\
a                                               &= 6 \times 3 \\\\
a                                               &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

Number of stickers $= 18$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{cost}                             &:& \text{stickers} \\\\
= & 40 \ \text{p}                             &:& 3 \\\\
= & 40 \times 6                             &:& 3 \times 6 \\\\
= & 240 \ \text{p}                            &:& 18 \\\\
= & \pounds 2.40                            &:& 18
\end{array}
$

Number of stickers $= 18$
</div>
</div>

$18$

</div>

**Question**

How much  would $33$ stickers cost? *(Give your answer in pounds.)*

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much  would $33$ stickers cost? *(Give your answer in pounds.)*
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 sticker}      &= \dfrac {40} {3} \ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Cost of 33 stickers}    &= \dfrac {40} {3} \times 33 \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {40 \times 33} {3} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {40 \times 3 \times 11} {3} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {40 \times \cancel 3 \times 11} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                              &= 40 \times 11 \\\\
                              &= 440 \ \text{p} \\\\
                              &= \pounds 4.40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of stickers $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \ \text{stickers} : 40 \ \text{p}               &= 33 \ \text{stickers} : a \ \text{p} \\\\
\dfrac{3} {40}                                  &= \dfrac {33} {a} \\\\
3 \times a                                      &= 33 \times 40 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {33 \times 40} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 11 \times 40} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 11 \times 40} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                                               &= 11 \times 40 \\\\
a                                               &= 440 \ \text{p} \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 4.40
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of stickers $= \pounds 4.4$
</div>

\end{array}
$
