<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many bales of hay does Jasper eat in $8\ \text{days}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many bales of hay does Jasper eat in $8\ \text{days}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of bales of hay}     &= 8 \times \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {8 \times 3} {4} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 3} {4} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 2 \times 3} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                                  &= 2 \times 3 \\\\
                                  &= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of bales of hay $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{days} : \dfrac {3} {4} \ \text{bales} &= 8 \ \text{days} : a \ \text{bales} \\\\
\dfrac{1} {\dfrac {3} {4}}                      &= \dfrac {8} {a} \\\\
a                                               &= 8 \times \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {8 \times 3} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 3} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 2 \times 3} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                               &= 2 \times 3 \\\\
a                                               &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

Number of bales of hay $= 6$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{days}                             &:& \text{bales} \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
= & 1 \times 8                              &:& \dfrac {3 \times 8} {4} \\\\
= & 8                                       &:& \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 2} {4} \\\\
= & 8                                       &:& \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4 \times 2} {\cancel 4} \\\\
= & 8                                       &:& 3 \times 2 \\\\
= & 8                                       &:& 6
\end{array}
$

Number of bales of hay $= 6$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6$

</div>
</div>

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many days does it take Jasper to eat $27 \ \text{bales}$ of hay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many days does it take Jasper to eat $27 \ \text{bales}$ of hay?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken }      &= \dfrac {\text{Total bales}} {\text{Bales eaten per day}} \\\\
                                  &= 27 \div \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
                                  &= 27 \times \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {27 \times 4} {3} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times 4} {3} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 9 \times 4} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                  &= 9 \times 4 \\\\
                                  &= 36 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of days $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {3} {4} \ \text{bales} : 1 \ \text{days} &= 27 \ \text{bales} : a \ \text{days} \\\\
\dfrac {3} {4}                                  &= \dfrac {27} {a} \\\\
3 \times a                                      &= 27 \times 4 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {27 \times 4} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times 4} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 9 \times 4} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                                               &= 9 \times 4 \\\\
a                                               &= 36
\end{aligned}
$

Number of days $= 36$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{bales}                            &:& \text{days} \\\\
= & \dfrac {3} {4}                          &:& 1 \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& 1 \times \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
= & 1 \times 27                             &:& \dfrac {4 \times 27} {3} \\\\
= & 27                                      &:& \dfrac {4 \times \cancel 3 \times 9} {\cancel 3} \\\\
= & 27                                      &:& 4 \times 9 \\\\
= & 27                                      &:& 36
\end{array}
$

Number of days $= 36$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$36$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">- rtq_abbr_note_md_divide_by_fraction
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken }      &= \dfrac {\text{Total bales}} {\text{Bales eaten per day}} \\\\
                                  &= 27 \div \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
                                  &= 27 \times \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {27 \times 4} {3} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times 4} {3} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 9 \times 4} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                  &= 9 \times 4 \\\\
                                  &= 36 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mr Cooper's car uses $3 \ \text{litres}$ of petrol to travel $50 \ \text{kilometres}$.

Petrol costs $\pounds 1.45$ per litre.

How much will Mr Cooper spend on petrol to drive $600 \ \text{kilometres}$ from Oxford to Glasgow?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mr Cooper's car uses $3 \ \text{litres}$ of petrol to travel $50 \ \text{kilometres}$.
<emptyline>
Petrol costs $\pounds 1.45$ per litre.
<emptyline>
How much will Mr Cooper spend on petrol to drive $600 \ \text{kilometres}$ from Oxford to Glasgow?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Petrol needed for 1 km}      &= \dfrac {3} {50} \\\\
\text {Petrol needed for 600 km}    &= \dfrac {3} {50} \times 600 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {3 \times 600} {50} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {3 \times 50 \times 12} {50} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {50} \times 12} {\cancel {50}} \\\\
                                    &= 3 \times 12 \\\\
                                    &= 36 \ \text{litres} \\\\
\text {Cost of the petrol}          &= 1.45 \times 36 \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 52.20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{km}                                     &:& \text{litres} \\\\
= & 50                                            &:& 3 \\\\
= & 1                                             &:& \dfrac {3} {50} \\\\
= & 1 \times 600                                  &:& \dfrac {3 \times 600} {50} \\\\
= & 600                                           &:& \dfrac {3 \times 50 \times 12} {50} \\\\
= & 600                                           &:& \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {50} \times 12} {\cancel {50}} \\\\
= & 600                                           &:& 3 \times 12 \\\\
= & 600 \ \text{km}                               &:& 36 \ \text{litres}
\end{array}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Petrol needed}       &= 36 \ \text{litres} \\\\
\text {Cost of the petrol}  &= 1.45 \times 36 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 52.20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 52.20$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

How many $20 \ \text{ml}$ portions of *Kleeno* are contained in one bottle?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

**Question**

How much *Kleeno* needs to be added to a bucket containing $10 \ \text{litres}$ of water?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much *Kleeno* needs to be added to a bucket containing $10 \ \text{litres}$ of water?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of Kleeno needed $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \ \text{litres} : 20 \ \text{ml}              &= 10 \ \text{litres} : a \ \text{ml} \\\\
\dfrac{4} {20}                                  &= \dfrac {10} {a} \\\\
4 \times a                                      &= 10 \times 20 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {10 \times 20} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {10 \times 4 \times 5} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {10 \times \cancel 4 \times 5} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                               &= 10 \times 5 \\\\
a                                               &= 50 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

Kleeno needed $= 50 \ \text{ml}$
</div>

= & 10 \ \text{litres}                      &:& 50 \ \text{ml}
\end{array}
$

Kleeno needed $= 50 \ \text{ml}$
</div>

**Question**

Maria uses $6 \ \text{litres}$ of water every time she cleans her kitchen.

She cleans her kitchen every day except for Sunday.

For how many weeks does a bottle of *Kleeno* last her?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

\dfrac{4} {20}                                  &= \dfrac {6} {a} \\\\

a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 20} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 4 \times 5} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel 4 \times 5} {\cancel 4} \\\\

                            &= \dfrac {30 \times 6 \times 3} {30 \times 6} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel {30} \times \cancel 6 \times 3} {\cancel {30} \times \cancel 6} \\\\
                            &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

**Question**

The mass of the fibre in a pack of '*Salmon pasta*' is $7 \ \text{grams}$.

What is the mass of '*Salmon pasta*' in the whole pack?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The mass of the fibre in a pack of '*Salmon pasta*' is $7 \ \text{grams}$.
<emptyline>
What is the mass of '*Salmon pasta*' in the whole pack?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the mass of salmon pasta $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \ \text{g} : 100 \ \text{g}                   &= 7 \ \text{g} : a \ \text{g} \\\\
\dfrac{2} {100}                                 &= \dfrac {7} {a} \\\\
2 \times a                                      &= 7 \times 100 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 100} {2} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 50 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 50 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a                                               &= 7 \times 50 \\\\
a                                               &= 350 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$

Mass of salmon pasta $= 350 \ \text{g}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{fibre}                            &:& \text{salmon pasta} \\\\
= & 2 \ \text{g}                            &:& 100 \ \text{g} \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& \dfrac {100} {2} \\\\
= & 7                                       &:& \dfrac {100 \times 7} {2} \\\\
= & 7                                       &:& \dfrac {2 \times 50 \times 7} {2} \\\\
= & 7                                       &:& \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 50 \times 7} {\cancel 2} \\\\
= & 7                                       &:& 50 \times 7 \\\\
= & 7 \ \text{g}                            &:& 350 \ \text{g}
\end{array}
$

Mass of salmon pasta $= 350 \ \text{g}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$350 \ \text {g}$

</div>

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \ \text{g} : 5 \ \text{g}                     &= 7 \ \text{g} : a \ \text{g} \\\\

\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$1 \ \text{cm}$ on a map represents a distance of $2 \ \text{km}$ on the ground. What is the distance in metres represented on the ground by $3 \ \text{mm}$ on the map?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$1 \ \text{cm}$ on a map represents a distance of $2 \ \text{km}$ on the ground. What is the distance in metres represented on the ground by $3 \ \text{mm}$ on the map?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the distance on ground in metres $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \times 10 \ \text{mm} : 2 \times 1000 \ \text{m}              &= 3 \ \text{mm} : a \ \text{m} \\\\
\dfrac {10} {2 \times 1000}                                     &= \dfrac {3} {a} \\\\
10 \times a                                                     &= 3 \times 2 \times 1000 \\\\
a                                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 2 \times 1000} {10} \\\\
a                                                               &= \dfrac {3 \times 2 \times 100 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0} \\\\
a                                                               &= 3 \times 2 \times 100 \\\\
a                                                               &= 600 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$

Distance on the ground $= 600 \ \text{m}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{map}                &:& \text{ground} \\\\
= & 1 \ \text{cm}             &:& 2 \ \text{km} \\\\
= & 1 \times 10 \ \text{mm}   &:& 2 \times 1000 \ \text{m} \\\\
= & 10                        &:& 2000 \\\\
= & 1                         &:& \dfrac{2000} {10} \\\\
= & 1 \times 3                &:& \dfrac{2000 \times 3} {10} \\\\
= & 3                         &:& \dfrac{200 \cancel 0 \times 3} {1 \cancel 0} \\\\
= & 3                         &:& 200 \times 3 \\\\
= & 3 \ \text{mm}             &:& 600 \ \text{m}
\end{array}
$

Distance on the ground $= 600 \ \text{m}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$600 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On a large weighing balance at Chester Zoo, the zookeepers find that $5$ rhinos on 
one side will balance $6$ zebras and $3$ rhinos on the other side. How many 
zebras would be needed to balance $9$ rhinos?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On a large weighing balance at Chester Zoo, the zookeepers find that $5$ rhinos on 
one side will balance $6$ zebras and $3$ rhinos on the other side. How many 
zebras would be needed to balance $9$ rhinos?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of zebras $= z$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
(5 - 3) \ \text{rhinos} : 6 \ \text{zebras}     &= 9 \ \text{rhinos} : z \ \text{zebras} \\\\
\dfrac{2} {6}                                   &= \dfrac {9} {z} \\\\
2 \times z                                      &= 9 \times 6 \\\\
z                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 6} {2} \\\\
z                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 3 \times 2} {2} \\\\
z                                               &= \dfrac {9 \times 3 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} \\\\
z                                               &= 9 \times 3 \\\\
z                                               &= 27
\end{aligned}
$

Number of zebras $= 27$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
= & \text{rhinos}       &:& \text{zebras} \\\\
= & 5 - 3               &:& 6 \\\\
= & 2                   &:& 6 \\\\
= & 1                   &:& \dfrac{6} {2} \\\\
= & 1 \times 9          &:& \dfrac{6 \times 9} {2} \\\\
= & 9                   &:& \dfrac{3 \times 2 \times 9} {2} \\\\
= & 9                   &:& \dfrac{3 \times \cancel 2 \times 9} {\cancel 2} \\\\
= & 9                   &:& 3 \times 9 \\\\
= & 9                   &:& 27
\end{array}
$

Number of zebras $= 27$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27$

</div>
</div>

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \ \text{red} : 3 \ \text{yellow}              &= 56 \ \text{red} : y \ \text{yellow} \\\\

y                                               &= 84
\end{aligned}
$

Number of yellow beads $= 84$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Hamster food costs $70 \ \text{p}$ for $40\, \text{grams}$.

What is the cost of $100\,\text{g}$ of hamster food.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Hamster food costs $70 \ \text{p}$ for $40\, \text{grams}$.
<emptyline>
What is the cost of $100\,\text{g}$ of hamster food.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 gram}       &= \dfrac {70} {40} \ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Cost of 100 grams}    &= 100 \times \dfrac {70} {40} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {100 \times 70} {40} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {25 \times 4 \times 7 \times 10} {4 \times 10} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {25 \times \cancel 4 \times 7 \times 1 \cancel 0} {\cancel 4 \times 1 \cancel 0} \\\\
                            &= 25 \times 7 \\\\
                            &= 175 \ \text{p} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 1.75
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of hamster food $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
40 \ \text{grams} : 70 \ \text{p}           &= 100 \ \text{grams} : a \ \text{p} \\\\
\dfrac {40} {70}                                &= \dfrac {100} {a} \\\\
40 \times a                                     &= 100 \times 70 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {100 \times 70} {40} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {25 \times 4 \times 7 \times 10} {4 \times 10} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {25 \times \cancel 4 \times 7 \times 1 \cancel 0} {\cancel 4 \times 1 \cancel 0} \\\\
a                                               &= 25 \times 7 \\\\
a                                               &= 175 \ \text{p} \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 1.75
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of hamster food $= \pounds 1.75$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{grams}                            &:& \text{p} \\\\
= & 40                                      &:& 70 \ \text{p} \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& \dfrac {70} {40} \\\\
= & 1 \times 100                            &:& \dfrac {70 \times 100} {40} \\\\
= & 100                                     &:& \dfrac {7 \times 10 \times 25 \times 4} {4 \times 10} \\\\
= & 100                                     &:& \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {10} \times 25 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4 \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
= & 100                                     &:& 7 \times 25 \\\\
= & 100 \ \text{g}                          &:& 175 \ \text{p} \\\\
= & 100 \ \text{g}                          &:& \pounds 1.75
\end{array}
$

Cost of hamster food $= \pounds 1.75$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.75$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A packet of sweets contains $15$ red, $25$ blue and $10$ green. A larger packet of sweets has the colours in the same ratio and contains $22$ green. How many blue are there in the larger packet.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A packet of sweets contains $15$ red, $25$ blue and $10$ green. A larger packet of sweets has the colours in the same ratio and contains $22$ green. How many blue are there in the larger packet.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of blue $= b$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
10 \ \text{green} : 25 \ \text{blue}            &= 22 \ \text{green} : b \ \text{blue} \\\\
\dfrac {10} {25}                                &= \dfrac {22} {b} \\\\
10 \times b                                     &= 22 \times 25 \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {22 \times 25} {10} \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {11 \times 2 \times 5 \times 5} {5 \times 2} \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {11 \times \cancel 2 \times 5 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
b                                               &= 11 \times 5 \\\\
b                                               &= 55
\end{aligned}
$

Blue in the larger packet $= 55$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{green}                            &:& \text{blue} \\\\
= & 10                                      &:& 25 \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& \dfrac {25} {10} \\\\
= & 1 \times 22                             &:& \dfrac {25 \times 22} {10} \\\\
= & 22                                      &:& \dfrac {5 \times 5 \times 2 \times 11} {2 \times 5} \\\\
= & 22                                      &:& \dfrac {5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times 11} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
= & 22                                      &:& 5 \times 11 \\\\
= & 22                                      &:& 55
\end{array}
$

Blue in the larger packet $= 55$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$55$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If nine identical books cost $\pounds 38.79$ together, how much would seven books cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If nine identical books cost $\pounds 38.79$ together, how much would seven books cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 book}       &= \dfrac {38.79} {9} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 4.31 \\\\
\text{Cost of 7 book}       &= 7 \times 4.31 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 30.17
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of seven books $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
9 \ \text{books} : \pounds 38.79                &= 7 \ \text{books} : \pounds a \\\\
\dfrac {9} {38.79}                              &= \dfrac {7} {a} \\\\
9 \times a                                      &= 7 \times 38.79 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 38.79} {9} \\\\
a                                               &= 7 \times 4.31 \\\\
a                                               &= \pounds 30.17
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of seven books $= \pounds 30.17$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{books}                            &:& \pounds \\\\
= & 9                                       &:& 38.79 \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& \dfrac {38.79} {9} \\\\
= & 1                                       &:& 4.31 \\\\
= & 1 \times 7                              &:& 4.31 \times 7 \\\\
= & 7                                       &:& \pounds 30.17
\end{array}
$

Cost of seven books $= \pounds 30.17$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 30.17$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many boys are in the class if there are $15$ girls?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many boys are in the class if there are $15$ girls?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of boys in the class $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \ \text{girls} : 2 \ \text{boys}              &= 15 \ \text{girls} : a \ \text{boys} \\\\
\dfrac {3} {2}                                  &= \dfrac {15} {a} \\\\
3 \times a                                      &= 15 \times 2 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {15 \times 2} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 2} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel 3 \times 2} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                                               &= 5 \times 2 \\\\
a                                               &= 10
\end{aligned}
$

Number of boys $= 10$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{girls}                            &:& \text{boys} \\\\
= & 3                                       &:& 2 \\\\
= & 3 \times 5                              &:& 2 \times 5 \\\\
= & 15                                      &:& 10
\end{array}
$

Number of boys $= 10$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10$

</div>
</div>

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many **more** girls than boys are there in a class of $35$ pupils?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many **more** girls than boys are there in a class of $35$ pupils?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of girls $= g$

Number of boys $= 35 - g$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \ \text{boys} : 3 \ \text{girls}              &= (35 - g) \ \text{boys} : g \ \text{girls} \\\\
\dfrac{2} {3}                                   &= \dfrac {35 - g} {g} \\\\
2 \times g                                      &= (35 - g) \times 3 \\\\
2g                                              &= 35 \times 3 - 3g \\\\
2g                                              &= 105 - 3g \\\\
2g + 3g                                         &= 105 \\\\
5g                                              &= 105 \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {105} {5} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times 21} {5} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 21} {\cancel 5} \\\\
g                                               &= 21 \\\\
\text{Number of girls}                          &= 21 \\\\
\text{Number of boys}                           &= 35 - 21 \\\\
                                                &= 14 \\\\
\text{Difference}                               &= 21 - 14 \\\\
                                                &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{whole}                      &:& \text{girls} \\\\
= & (2 + 3)                           &:& 3 \\\\
= & 5                                 &:& 3 \\\\
= & 5 \times 7                        &:& 3 \times 7 \\\\
= & 35                                &:& 21
\end{array}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of girls}        &= 21 \\\\
\text{Number of boys}         &= 35 - 21 \\\\
                              &= 14 \\\\
\text{Difference}             &= 21 - 14 \\\\
                              &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the number of girls $= g$
<emptyline>
Number of boys $= 35 - g$
<emptyline>
Using equivalent ratio,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
2 \ \text{boys} : 3 \ \text{girls}              &= (35 - g) \ \text{boys} : g \ \text{girls} \\\\
\dfrac{2} {3}                                   &= \dfrac {35 - g} {g} \\\\
2 \times g                                      &= (35 - g) \times 3 \\\\
2g                                              &= 35 \times 3 - 3g \\\\
2g                                              &= 105 - 3g \\\\
2g + 3g                                         &= 105 \\\\
5g                                              &= 105 \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {105} {5} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times 21} {5} \\\\
g                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 21} {\cancel 5} \\\\
g                                               &= 21 \\\\
\text{Number of girls}                          &= 21 \\\\
\text{Number of boys}                           &= 35 - 21 \\\\
                                                &= 14 \\\\
\text{Difference}                               &= 21 - 14 \\\\
                                                &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Using whole to part ratio,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{whole}                      &:& \text{girls} \\\\
= & (2 + 3)                           &:& 3 \\\\
= & 5                                 &:& 3 \\\\
= & 5 \times 7                        &:& 3 \times 7 \\\\
= & 35                                &:& 21
\end{array}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of girls}        &= 21 \\\\
\text{Number of boys}         &= 35 - 21 \\\\
                              &= 14 \\\\
\text{Difference}             &= 21 - 14 \\\\
                              &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
